description: From the heights of the Himalayas to the southern coasts of the South China Sea, winding over 2,700 miles, the Mekong is much more than just irrigation for Indochinaeverywhere it flows, it fascinates men and shapes their lives. Come take an expedition on this grand and plentiful water snake, from Siem Reap to the river Tonle Sap  following the footsteps of Henri Mouhot, then Phnom Penh and Ho Chi Minh City, still largely influenced by the French colonial days. Our meditative trip takes you along the Mekong River on board a ship combining charm and colonial-style comfort.

itinerary.description: Meeting at 1 p.m. at the hotel Lotus Blanc(1) (ships: RV Indochine I and Lan Diep) and the hotel Sofitek Angkor(1) (ship: RV Indochine II).Journey to Koh Chen (approximately 5 to 6 hours by coach), with a stop in traditional villages. Our crew will welcome you and help you get comfortably settled into your cabins. ORTransfer to your ship. Our crew will welcome you and help you get comfortably settled into your cabins. Afternoon cruise through Tonle Lake.Well have dinner and formally meet our crew. Our ship will remain anchored overnight.
We'll arrive in Koh Chen. Lunch on board, then we will set out to visit the beautiful Vihara at the Wat Kampong Tralach Leu pagoda. We'll spend the night on board.

Well visit Kampong Chhnang, one of the largest fishing ports. Lunch and cruising towards Phnom Penh, arriving in the early evening. Enjoy a brief tour of the area by "tuk-tuk," the easiest way to get around the city. Well return to the ship and enjoy a performance of classical Khmer dancing and music and have dinner.

Well enjoy a tour of the fabulous Royal Palace. Onward to visit the National Museum. After lunch in town, you can pay a visit to the Tuol Svay Prey School, a former detention, torture, and execution center run by the Khmer Rouge during the civil war. We'll return on board, cruising to Chau Doc. We'll spend the night on board.

Located on the border between Cambodia and Vietnam, the prosperous city of Chau Doc has developed around fish and fish farming. Floating farms invade the waters. Visit to the Tay An Pagoda and the Ba Chua Xu Temple. Lunch. Once we are back on board, well begin to cruise toward Sa Dec. Well spend the night on board.

Visit the former house of Huynh Thuy Le, the man who Marguerite Duras based her book The Lover on. Free time in Sa Dec. Lunch on board and cruise to Vinh Long. Arriving in Cai Be. Well discover a brick and pottery factory as well as a traditional factory producing puffed riced, rice-paper wrappers used to make nems, and rice alcohol*. Well return on board our ship and begin to cruise. Well have dinner and spend the night on board.

itinerary.port: Cái Bè / Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: We'll visit a bee farm and enjoy some honey tea and exotic fruit. We'll then take a ride in small sampans along the canal lined with mangrove palms. Lunch will be served on board. We'll then set out to cross the very narrow Chao Gao Canal, heading for Ho Chi Minh City. We'll have dinner and remain in port overnight in the downtown area.

Ho Chi Minh City was heavily influenced by French colonialism in the 19th century. Well enjoy a tour of the city to see the Reunification Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, and the Saigon Central Post Office, and visit the Museum of Vietnamese History. Lunch will be served on board. In the afternoon, we'll enjoy free time on board or well leave by coach for the Cu Chi tunnels (coach journey of approximately 2 hours and 15 minutes each way), an immense network of underground tunnels that were used by Viet Cong soldiers as hiding spots during combat, as well as serving as communication and supply routes, hospitals, food and weapon caches. After our excursion, we'll return on board our ship. Tonight well have our farewell cocktail and dinner. We'll remain in port overnight.

Disembarking. Well spend the morning visiting Cholon, the Chinese-influenced section of the city, including its hectic market. After lunch in town, well bid you farewell at approximately 2:00 p.m. Please do not book your flight before 5:00 p.m.

title: The Mekong in a different way - Between adventure and must-seesites (port-to-port cruise)
description: We are thrilled to present our latest program, designed to combine exploration, cultural immersion, and light activities for a memorable cruising experience on-board the Toum Tiou 2. Our charming vessel offers personalized service in an intimate environment, perfect for small groups who seek an authentic and dynamic Mekong River journey. Our itinerary includes a range of activities like biking, kayaking, sampan rides and walking tours that provide opportunities to discover the hidden treasures of the Mekong River, including traditional village visits and climbing the stunning Udong Hill. Moreover, we'll take you on a motor & rowing boat tour of the magnificent Tra Su Forest, where you'll witness incredible flora and fauna of this beautiful natural environment. Experience the perfect balance of cultural immersion and light adventure, while enjoying the authentic Mekong River charm. With an emphasis on personalized service, cultural exploration, and a touch of adventure, our program promises to deliver an unforgettable cruising experience and makes a perfect match for the Toum Tiou 2.

itinerary.description: Meet at the restaurant of the Hotel Liberty Riverside between 11:30 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. Lunch at the hotel. After lunch, we will explore the local Chinatown and experience the daily life of the people. we will also visit the Giac Lam Pagoda, which is over 300 years old and is the oldest pagoda in Ho Chi Minh City. Lastly, we will visit the Flower Market and Binh Tay market for a 15-minute walking tour to explore how locals buy and sell local food and products.Transfer to the ship.After comfortably settling into your cabins, we will introduce our crew at a welcome cocktail.Dinner followed by the "Saigon After Dark" excursion, it is a part night excursion, part street/local food adventure from 6pm to 10pm (included for departures from January to April 2026, optional for departures from August 2026 (1)).Guests experience the nightlife of Saigon the way locals do. An evening excursion with a culinary adventure. On the back of a vintage Vespa scooter, you'll enter the heart of Saigon's nightlife. From stop to stop, you'll sample local flavors, including cocktails, seafood tastings, cold drinks and Vietnamese creperies.After this, the tour will bring you to a live music venue to enjoy the drinks with live music.

Enjoy a tasty breakfast onboard before our Ho Chi Minh City tour. Take a short downtown drive to the city. Transfer back to ship for lunch.After lunch we will then proceed to the War Museum to learn more about the history of Vietnam before returning to the ship.Ship leaves Saigon for My Tho and dinner on board.Night on board.

Breakfast on board and cruise the magnificent Chao Gao canal, where you will experience the lively and vibrant canal full of ships activity, yet still feel close to the life on shore. A must-see part of the cruise and that we're the only cruise line offering this unique passage. Arrival in My Tho.In My Tho we will kick off with a local boat pick-up that will take us on a boat cruise to Thoi Son Island where we will have the opportunity to explore the daily lives of the local people and enjoy seasonal fruits. Back to ship. Ship leaves for Cai Be and we will enjoy lunch whilst cruising. Arrival at Cai Be. Disembark to visit the craft village where you can witness how the local products are made.Continue cruising on the boat. We will then enjoy a kayaking adventure. Ship leaves Cai Be for Sa Dec. Dinner during cruising and night on board.
Breakfast on board.Local boat pick-up for a short panoramic tour of Sa Dec.Ship leaves Sa Dec for Chau Doc, lunch and dinner on board during cruising.

Located on the border between Cambodia and Vietnam, the prosperous town of Chau Doc has developed around fishing and fish farming. Well then transfer to Tra Su Forest. Well experience this beautiful forest with small local boats, where you can witness this incredible and diverse flora and fauna. Return to the boat for lunch.In the afternoon, we will board a cable car and embark on an unforgettable journey to Sam mountain. Continuation to the Vinh Xuong border. Customs clearance and entry formalities into Cambodia. Set sail for Phnom Penh, which you will reach in the evening. Dinner on board, overnight at anchor.

Breakfast on board.We will enjoy a tour of the fabulous Royal Palace, one of the most impressive examples of Cambodian architecture, and its Silver Pagoda. Onward to visit the National Museum.Enjoy an afternoon tour of the area by "tuk-tuk," for an authentic and immersive experience like no other. Continue your visit to the city's namesake, Wat Phnom.As we get back on board, we will enjoy an Apsara dance show. Dinner and overnight on board, in the port of Phnom Penh. Free evening.

Departure by ship towards Kampong Tralach. Visit the beautiful Vihara of the Wat Kampong Tralach Leu pagoda.Lunch on board.Departure towards Oudong, which was the royal residence and capital of Cambodia for over 250 years. Visit the Vipassana Dhura Pagoda.Departure by boat towards Kampong Chhnang. Dinner and overnight on board.

Visit Kampong Chhnang, one of the largest fishing ports on the Tonle Sap Lake. Option: For those seeking more activity, there will be an option at Kampong Chhnang to cycle alongside the riverside and then to the pottery village to explore this area. Return to the ship, lunch on board whilst cruising to Koh Chen.We will have a farewell dinner and spend the night on board.

Disembark, road to Siem Reap and discovery of traditional villages (5-6 hours bus ride).After, we'll visit the Angkor Wat temple: the epitome of Khmer architectural art and the most famous and imposing of all the monuments in Angkor (visitors must cover their shoulders and wear long pants or a long skirt). Enjoy a stroll through the Angkor Night Market. Dinner and overnight in hotel.

Boat trip on Tonl Lake to discover the floating villages and the traditional life of its inhabitants. Lunch. Visit of the Senteurs d'Angkor, a local business with a diverse collection of silk and carvings, as well as a superb range of traditional beauty products and spices, all made locally. Well end the day with Phare, the Cambodian circus, and spend the night at the hotel.

This morning, well tour Ta Prohm, a Cambodian temple dedicated to the family of Jayavarman VII. Well then explore Angkor Thom. Stroll among the enigmatic faces of the Bayon Temple and discover the Terrace of the Elephants and the Terrace of the Leper King. Lunch will be served at the hotel.Well bid you farewell at approximately 2:00 p.m. Please do not book your flight before 5:00 p.m.

title: The Mekong in a different way - Between adventure and must-see sites (port-to-port cruise)
description: As a prelude to this active cruise, admire the magnificent temples of Angkor. Listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, this 400 km2 archaeological site contains priceless relics such as the sanctuary of Ta Prohm, a prisoner of lichen and strangling fig trees, Bayon and its enigmatic four-faced stone sentinels, the Terrace of the Elephants, the scene of royal parades, and above all Angkor Wat, the site's most famous temple.We are thrilled to present our latest program, designed to combine exploration, cultural immersion, and light activities for a memorable cruising experience on-board the Toum Tiou 2. Our charming vessel offers personalized service in an intimate environment, perfect for small groups who seek an authentic and dynamic Mekong River journey. Our itinerary includes a range of activities like biking, kayaking, sampan rides and walking tours that provide opportunities to discover the hidden treasures of the Mekong River, including traditional village visits and climbing the stunning Udong Hill. Moreover, we'll take you on a motor & rowing boat tour of the magnificent Tra Su Forest, where you'll witness incredible flora and fauna of this beautiful natural environment. Experience the perfect balance of cultural immersion and light adventure, while enjoying the authentic Mekong River charm. With an emphasis on personalized service, cultural exploration, and a touch of adventure, our program promises to deliver an unforgettable cruising experience and makes a perfect match for the Toum Tiou 2.

itinerary.description: Your program will begin according to your time of arrival. If your flight arrives between 6:00 a.m. and 11:00 a.m., your program will be: Lunch will be served at the hotel.Take a boat trip on Tonl Lake to discover the floating villages and the traditional life of its inhabitants. Then, visit of the Angkor Night Market. Well have dinner in the city and spend the night at a four-star hotel.

Full-day included excursion: the Ta Prohm temple, Angkor Thom, the Bayon Temple,the Terrace of the Elephants and the Terrace of the Leper King. Lunch and visit of the Senteurs d'Angkor.Well end the day with Phare, the Cambodian circus.Night at the hotel.

Included excursion: the Angkor Wat temple.Youll be transferred to your ship.After comfortably settling into your cabins, well introduce our crew at a welcome cocktail.We'll spend the night on the ship.

Sail to Kampong Chhnang and lunch on board. Visit Kampong Chhnang, one of the largest fishing ports on the Tonle Sap Lake. Option: For those seeking more activity, there will be an option at Kampong Chhnang to cycle alongside the riverside and then to the pottery village to explore this area. We'll have dinner and spend the night on board.

Breakfast on board.We will head to Oudong, which was the royal residence and the capital of Cambodia for over 250 years. Visit the Vipassana Dhura Pagoda, located at the foot of a hill where many stupas from the last Khmer kings can be found.Lunch on board.In the afternoon, visit the beautiful Vihara of the Wat Kampong Tralach Leu pagoda.We then offer clients to return to the ship by enjoying a mountain biking experience through the stunning countryside to witness the beauty of the rice fields surrounding the area before returning to the ship.After returning on board, start cruising towards Phnom Penh. Enjoy a performance of classical Khmer dancing and music then dinner. Night on board.

Breakfast on board. We'll enjoy a tour of the fabulous Royal Palace, one of the most impressive examples of Cambodian architecture, and its Silver Pagoda. Onward to visit the National Museum. Enjoy an afternoon tour of the area by "tuk-tuk," for an authentic and immersive experience like no other. We'll return on board for dinner in the evening and start sailing towards Vietnam. Night on board.

Breakfast on board. Arrival at Vinh Xuong border. Customs clearance and entry formalities, departure for Chau Doc. Situated on the border between Cambodia and Vietnam, the prosperous town of Chau Doc has developed around fishing and fish farming. Well experience this beautiful forest with small local boats, where you can witness this incredible and diverse flora and fauna. Return to the boat for lunch.In the afternoon, we will board a cable car and embark on an unforgettable journey to Sam mountain. Continuation to Sa Dec, dinner and overnight on board.

Breakfast on board. Local boat picks up for a short panoramic tour of Sa Dec, including a promenade at Sa Dec market on the riverbank.Ship leaves Sa Dec for Cai Be. Cai Be offers many exciting attractions, activities, and excursions. Disembark to visit the craft village where you can witness how the local products are made. Continue cruising on the boat. Get off at the fruit orchards comprising of many kinds of fruits such as: jack-fruit, durian, guava, rambutan, longan etc... drink hot tea, eat fresh fruits and enjoy a live local music performance. Head to the local restaurant by boat, attend a cooking class with local chef, then enjoy your lunch. After lunch, take a rest, then enjoy a kayaking adventure. Ship leaves Cai Be for My Tho. Dinner during cruising and night on board.

itinerary.port: Cái Bè / Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: In My Tho we will kick off our day with a local boat pick-up that will take us on a boat cruise to Thoi Son Island where we will have the opportunity to explore the daily lives of the local people and enjoy seasonal fruits. Lunch on board and cruise the magnificent Chao Gao canal, the entrance to Saigon where you will experience the lively and vibrant canal full of ships and activity, yet still feel close to the life on shore. A must-see part of the cruise and that we're the only cruise line offering this unique passage.Arrive in Saigon.Dinner followed by the "Saigon After Dark" excursion, it is a part night excursion, part street/local food adventure from 6pm to 10pm (included for departures from January to April 2026, optional for departures from August 2026 (1)).After this, the tour will bring you to a live music venue to enjoy the drinks with live music.

Enjoy a tasty breakfast on board before our Ho Chin Minh city tour. Transfer back to ship for lunch.After lunch, we'll explore the local Chinatown and experience the daily life of the people. We'll also visit the Giac Lam Pagoda, which is over 300 years old and is the oldest pagoda in Ho Chi Minh City. Lastly, we'll visit the Flower Market and Binh Tay market for a 15-minute walking tour to explore how locals buy and sell local food and products.Transfer to the ship to enjoy our farewell cocktail and dinner onboard.We'll remain in port overnight.

Enjoy breakfast on board before disembarking. We'll then proceed to the War Museum to learn more about the history of Vietnam.Then, we'll transfer to a local restaurant for lunch.We'll bid you farewell at approximately 2:00 p.m. Please do not book your flight before 5:00 p.m.

title: Safari Cruise along the Zambezi River - South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Zimbabwe (port-to-port cruise)
description: From Johannesburg to Victoria Falls, youll discover spectacular panoramas and tumultuous histories, but also incredible wildlife and carefully crafted menus that reflect the flavors and savors of Africa, as well as the most beautiful natural reserves and the secrets of Lake Kariba before taking in the grandeur of the smoke that thunders, Victoria Falls.
whats_included: Alcohol and Soft Drinks during Bar hours

itinerary.description: Well meet up at the hotel at 11:30 a.m. Well have lunch before visiting the Apartheid Museum (the Museum is open from Tuesday to Sunday. In case of a visit a Monday, this museum will be replaced by the Mandela House.) Afterwards, well set off for a panoramic tour of Johannesburg, the city of superlatives. Well arrive at our five-star hotel LS. Youll enjoy dinner and spend the night at the hotel.

We'll take a regular flight from Johannesburg to Kasane, Botswana. You'll be transferred from the airport to your CroisiEurope lodge on board small private boats. You'll settle into your comfortable lodge ideally located at the heart of the wilderness. We'll have dinner and spend the night at the lodge.

Enjoy a full-day dedicated to the discovery of Chobe National Park and its majestic fauna.African lunch in the heart of nature. Afterwards, well board small private boats and sail off on Chobe River all the way to Sedudu Island and its marshes. Well have dinner and spend the night at the lodge.

Discover traditional villages on Impalila Island. Well return to our lodge for lunch. This afternoon, you can enjoy time at leisure at the lodge, then join us for a discovery of the Zambezi River on small private boats. Well have dinner at the lodge. Tonight, let your guide tell you all about the traditions of this particular island. Night spent at the lodge.

Enjoy one last water safari in the Chobe National Park area. After lunch along the water, we'll set out for the Kasane airport. On board small private planes, youll discover the stunning panoramas during your flightto Lake Kariba(1). Youll be transferred to board the ship and comfortably settle into your cabins. Well have dinner and spend the night on board.

At sunrise, well set sail through Lake Kariba. Well set out on a small private boat to discover the small waterways going into the Matusadona National Park and their unique wildlife. Well return on board for lunch. The afternoon will be spend cruising. Later, we'll set out on small private boats to admire the sunset. Well have dinner and spend the night on board.

We'll journey out this morning on a safari to discover the area around Matusadona National Park and its numerous wild animals. We'll enjoy lunch on board and start sailing again. During this time, a round table will be the opportunity to learn more about the creation of the Lake, its inhabitants as well as its ecosystem. We'll have dinner and spend the night on board.

At sunrise,well set sail towards Kariba to disembark and journey out to the airport.Well fly out to Victoria Falls on board private planes. Enjoy an exceptional lunch cruise on the Zambezi River, upstream from the falls. Afternoon at leisure, with moments of relaxation by the hotel pool and views over the surrounding savannah.Optional: Helicopter flight over Victoria Falls.Optional: A unique opportunity for a final safari through the wild landscapes of a private reserve! This time, set off in a comfortable 4x4 vehicle in search of Africas black rhinos, accompanied by an experienced ranger. (Excursions are compatible and take place one after the other. Must be booked at the time of registration. The safari is offered on a private basis and accompanied by our guide for CroisiEurope passengers from 6 participants. Below this number, participants may join other clients without accompaniment.)Tonight, enjoy dinner and spend the night at a four-star hotel LS.

Breakfast. Well leave for a tour on foot of the falls where the views are among the most exceptional in the world. Well also see where the Zambezi River plunges over the cliff to become the widest waterfall in the world, creating the smoke that thunders. End of our services at the hotelaround 10:30 am. Do not schedule a flight before 2:00 pm.

The end in Berlin Spandau combines big city flair and water idyll - an impressive river journey across Germany that harmoniously combines culture, nature and history.

title: Rhine`s Short Greeting
description:
Autumn Getaway 2026

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €100 flight credit towards your journey. The credit applies to flights booked through VIVA Cruises.

 

Experience an unforgettable short trip along the Rhine, taking you from Düsseldorf to Mainz. This trip is ideal for culture lovers, nature enthusiasts, and those who enjoy the finer things in life and are looking for a short getaway without sacrificing variety.

Your journey begins downstream from Düsseldorf, the modern metropolis on the Rhine. In Bonn, the former federal capital, the idyllic old town awaits you with its historic facades and charming alleyways. Don’t miss the Beethoven House, a cultural highlight for music lovers.

The journey continues to Koblenz, where you can reach the imposing Ehrenbreitstein Fortress by cable car—a truly memorable experience with panoramic views of the famous Deutsches Eck, where the Rhine and Moselle rivers meet.

In Rüdesheim, discover the famous Drosselgasse, savor fine wines from the surrounding vineyards, and experience the warm Rhineland hospitality. The surrounding area is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site Upper Middle Rhine Valley and offers a picturesque backdrop of castles, vineyards, and stunning river landscapes.

The grand finale is Mainz, a city brimming with history and life. Visit the Mainz Cathedral, stroll through the lively Old Town with its half-timbered houses, and enjoy a glass of Riesling in one of the cozy wine taverns.

This trip combines culture, history, culinary delights, and scenic beauty into an unforgettable experience along the Rhine—compact, varied, and inspiring.

 

Look forward to having Günther Neefs on board for the following trip: November 16–19, 2026

title: Festive Danube
description:
Go on a fascinating journey along the Danube, where cultural treasures and breathtaking landscapes await you. Start in Nuremberg, a city full of history and charm, whose imposing castle and lovingly restored old town form the prelude to your journey. From there, the river takes you to Regensburg, which will delight you with its medieval splendor, the impressive Stone Bridge and the old town center, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Continue on to Passau, the famous "City of Three Rivers", where the Danube, Inn and Ilz rivers meet. Here you can admire the baroque St. Stephen's Cathedral with the largest cathedral organ in the world. Afterwards, Linz awaits you, a lively city that unites tradition and modernity in a unique way - whether in the historic center or in the futuristic Ars Electronica Center.

The journey continues through the picturesque Wachau, a region full of vineyards, castle ruins and romantic villages, before coming to a crowning conclusion in Vienna. The Austrian capital enchants with its majestic architecture, including St. Stephen's Cathedral, the Hofburg and Schönbrunn Palace, as well as a cultural diversity that ranges from classical music to modern art and coffee house culture.

This trip combines the natural beauty of the Danube with its cultural richness - an experience that will remain unforgettable.

From the warm crew, whose high service standards always have top priority. Of culinary highlights ranging from gourmet dinners to live cooking. And of moments in which excitement and relaxation alternate in the most beautiful way. Look forward to an exceptional river cruise ship!

title: Culinary Delights Of Normandy
description:
An unparalleled variety, aesthetic, and preparation: French cuisine is admired around the world and holds a unique reputation. Quality and pleasure are deeply ingrained in the culinary culture of the land of Haute Cuisine. Join us and dive right in!

Experience the culinary treasures of France up close – from the sophisticated creations of Michelin-starred chefs to the simple yet delicious regional specialties. Whether it's a fragrant baguette straight from the bakery, a creamy Camembert from Normandy, or a beautifully presented Coq au Vin, each dish tells a story and reflects the French passion for food.

Explore with us the diverse regional flavors: the Provence region delights with its Mediterranean herbs, Brittany offers the taste of fresh seafood, and Burgundy invites you to indulge in fine wines and hearty meat dishes. Market strolls, wine tastings, and cooking classes offer deep insights into French food culture and traditional preparation techniques.

Our journey is an invitation not just to taste, but to indulge all your senses. Learn how to prepare French classics yourself and be inspired by the passion with which the French cook. This trip will be a true feast for the senses – full of flavors, colors, and stories.

title: Crime thriller trip to Berlin
description: The journey begins in Düsseldorf, where modern architecture and the lively old town welcome visitors. Along the Rhine, the cruise heads to Duisburg, home to Europe’s largest inland port. Here, industrial structures meet green parks and riverbanks. Via the Rhine-Herne Canal, the ship reaches Herne Ost, in the Ruhr area, where former coal mines and cultural projects contrast with natural floodplains. In Münster, Westphalia reveals its charm. The cathedral, historic market square, and cycle-friendly avenues highlight a city surrounded by meadows and rivers. Further north lies Minden, with its impressive waterway cross where the Weser meets the Mittelland Canal. The surrounding landscape features rolling hills and wide fields. Wolfsburg combines technology and nature, with the Autostadt, castle, and forests along the canal. At Rothensee, the giant lock and canal bridges mark a technical wonder before arriving in Burg bei Magdeburg, where towers and the Elbe floodplains dominate. In Brandenburg an der Havel, medieval history blends with a lakescape rich in forests and waterways. The journey continues to Potsdam, famous for Sanssouci Palace and elegant parks in a unique cultural landscape. Finally, the cruise ends in Berlin Spandau, where history and modernity meet along the Havel. The Spandau Citadel and green surroundings provide the perfect finale to a diverse voyage through cities, landscapes, and waterways.

description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Experience an extraordinary river cruise through the heart of Germany during the atmospheric month of November. Your journey begins in Berlin-Spandau and takes you along the idyllic Havel River to Potsdam, where magnificent palaces and parklands await you. Traveling along the Mittelland Canal, you’ll discover fascinating places like Haldensleben, Calvörde, and Wolfsburg—an exciting blend of nature, technology, and history.

The journey continues westward to Minden and Münster, where Westphalian charm and historic old towns will captivate you. Traveling along the Ruhr, you’ll reach Duisburg-Ruhrort before your journey finally concludes in the elegant Rhine metropolis of Düsseldorf.

Enjoy relaxing days on board, impressive waterways, and varied excursions. This journey combines cultural highlights, tranquil nature, and unique perspectives on Germany’s diverse regions—perfect for a leisurely getaway this fall.

title: A Symphony of Color & Splendor
description:
Experience an unforgettable river cruise through some of Europe’s most fascinating cities. Starting in Düsseldorf, the journey first takes you to Amsterdam, the vibrant Dutch capital, famous for its scenic canals, world-class museums, and lively atmosphere. The voyage continues to Rotterdam, renowned for its striking modern architecture and Europe’s largest port.

Next, discover Antwerp, the Belgian gem known for its rich history, impressive cathedrals, and the world-famous diamond district. In Dordrecht, one of the oldest cities in the Netherlands, you can stroll through the charming old town framed by canals.

In Arnhem, you will experience both nature at Hoge Veluwe National Park and fascinating history at the famous “Arnhem Bridge.” The cruise concludes back in Düsseldorf, where your unforgettable journey comes to an end.

This itinerary combines culture, heritage, nature, and vibrant urban life into a unique travel experience.

title: From Modern Marvels to Fairytale Alsace
description:
The river cruise begins in Düsseldorf, a city of contrasts: modern architecture along the Rhine, the elegant Königsallee, and the lively old town, known as the “longest bar in the world.”

The first stop is Niederlahnstein, beautifully set at the confluence of the Rhine and Lahn. Medieval castles, timber-framed houses, and a romantic atmosphere invite exploration.

Sailing past the legendary Loreley rock is a highlight of the journey. The dramatic cliffs and myths surrounding this place make it unforgettable.

In Mannheim, the grid-style city surprises with its baroque palace and vibrant arts scene. Soon after comes Strasbourg, where French charm and German heritage blend. The cathedral, “La Petite France,” and European institutions make it a cultural gem.

Back in Germany, Rüdesheim welcomes visitors with the famous Drosselgasse, filled with wine and music. A cable car ride to the Niederwald Monument offers panoramic views.

In Königswinter, at the foot of the Drachenfels, travelers enjoy a scenic railway ride to the summit, with sweeping views of the Rhine Valley and castle ruins steeped in legend.

Finally, the ship returns to Düsseldorf, where art, culture, and Rhineland joie de vivre provide the perfect finale to a cruise full of variety and discovery.

title: Paris & Seine Rendezvous
description:
On this trip, Paris and the Seine come together to create a unique blend of a river cruise and a city stay. From the French capital, the VIVA BEYOND first takes you to Poissy, where French charm and the proximity to magnificent castles and gardens beckon. Further downstream, Rouen awaits you with its historic half-timbered houses, winding alleys, and imposing cathedral. In Les Andelys, Normandy shows off its picturesque side: high above the Seine, the ruins of Château Gaillard tower over the landscape, offering breathtaking views of the river valley.

You’ll then return to Paris - but your journey is far from over. The VIVA BEYOND remains your home on the water while you have three full days to explore the French metropolis. Discover famous landmarks, charming neighborhoods, and hidden gems entirely at your own pace. Whether it’s a stroll through Montmartre, art and culture at the Louvre, a coffee in the Marais, or an evening along the Seine: you decide what your Paris experience will look like. This trip combines relaxing days on the river with an exceptionally enriching stay in one of the most beautiful cities in the world.

title: A Journey Through Imperial Footsteps
description:
The Danube cruise begins in Budapest, the “Pearl of the Danube.” The Hungarian capital enchants with the Parliament’s grandeur, the Fisherman’s Bastion, and the Chain Bridge, while the hills of Buda contrast with lively Pest.

The next stop is Bratislava, nestled between the Little Carpathians and the river. Its castle overlooks a charming old town filled with baroque palaces and cozy cafés.

A scenic highlight follows in the Wachau Valley, a UNESCO World Heritage Site of vineyards and orchards. Here lies Melk, famous for its Benedictine abbey, a masterpiece of baroque architecture towering above the river.

In Passau, where the Danube meets the Inn and Ilz, guests experience a unique riverscape. The St. Stephen’s Cathedral, home to the world’s largest cathedral organ, and the colorful old town make the city special.

Further downstream lies Linz, blending baroque heritage with contemporary culture. Its main square, historic buildings, and modern art institutions create a vibrant setting framed by green hills.

The journey ends in Vienna, Austria’s imperial capital. Palaces like Schönbrunn and the Hofburg, the majestic St. Stephen’s Cathedral, and the riverbanks combine imperial history with modern vibrancy – a perfect finale to this unforgettable Danube cruise.

title: Summer Elegance Along the Danube
description:
The journey begins in Nuremberg, a city rich in history. The Imperial Castle, the medieval old town with timber-framed houses, and traditional crafts provide a memorable start. As the ship moves towards the Danube, rolling hills and small villages pass by along the riverbanks.

In Regensburg, one of the best-preserved medieval towns in Germany, highlights include the Gothic cathedral, the Stone Bridge, and narrow streets full of history. Merchant houses line the river, and the city’s UNESCO World Heritage status becomes clear.

The cruise continues to Passau, where the Danube, Inn, and Ilz meet. Its baroque old town, St. Stephen’s Cathedral with the world’s largest organ, and surrounding hills make for a striking impression.

A scenic highlight follows at Melk, in the Wachau Valley. The Benedictine Abbey towers above the river, surrounded by vineyards and orchards. The gently curving landscape invites admiration.

Nearby lies Krems, nestled among vineyards. With small streets, historic buildings, and a legacy as a trading town, it offers charm and authenticity.

The grand finale is Vienna, the imperial capital on the Danube. The cathedral, Ringstrasse, palaces, coffeehouse culture, and vibrant music scene combine with modern life. A walk through the Prater or an evening concert crown the journey. This cruise blends culture, history, and breathtaking landscapes into an unforgettable experience.

title: Crime Cruise to Bremen
description:
The river cruise begins in Berlin Spandau, where the Havel River flows past green banks and bridges. Soon, Potsdam enchants with palaces, parks, and lakes – Sanssouci Palace and the royal gardens shine in baroque splendor.

The route continues to Genthin, a town marked by waterways and inland shipping traditions, surrounded by fields and quiet villages. In Rothensee, near Magdeburg, the impressive ship lift demonstrates remarkable engineering, connecting the Elbe with the Mittelland Canal.

Wolfsburg offers a glimpse of modern industry through the Volkswagen plant and the Autostadt, while its natural surroundings provide calm and balance. In Braunschweig, medieval heritage unfolds at the Burgplatz with its cathedral and lion statue.

In Hanover, nature and city combine: Herrenhausen Gardens, contemporary buildings, and the Maschsee offer variety and charm. Minden fascinates with its waterway crossing, where the canal flows above the Weser.

Through tranquil Stolzenau, guests experience the quiet countryside, before reaching Bremen. The Hanseatic city impresses with its UNESCO-listed town hall and Roland statue, the Bremen Town Musicians, and maritime flair along the Weser – a fitting finale to a diverse journey.

title: From Budapest to Vienna
description:
Experience the beauty of the Danube on a memorable river cruise from Budapest to Vienna. Your journey begins in the vibrant Hungarian capital, renowned for its impressive architecture, rich history, and lively atmosphere. Continue to historic Komárno before exploring the charming streets of Bratislava, where centuries of history blend with a modern European spirit.

Cruise through the picturesque Wachau Valley, one of the Danube's most beautiful regions, and discover the charming town of Dürnstein as well as the magnificent Melk Abbey. After visiting the lively city of Linz, your journey concludes in elegant Vienna. With its imperial landmarks, famous cafés, and timeless charm, Austria's capital provides the perfect finale to a cruise filled with culture, history, and spectacular scenery.

title: Winter Highlights on the Main
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €100 flight credit towards your journey. The credit applies to flights booked through VIVA Cruises.

For the following departures:

  • 4–8 November 2026
  • 12–16 November 2026
  • 20–24 November 2026
  • 28 November–2 December 2026
  • 14–18 December 2026

Immerse yourself in the idyllic world of the River Main on a journey that harmoniously combines nature, history, and culture. Your adventure begins in Frankfurt, the vibrant metropolis known for its striking skyline, where modern skyscrapers blend with historic landmarks like the Römer, St. Bartholomew's Cathedral, and the Museum Embankment.

From there, the Main River winds its way through some of the most picturesque river landscapes in Germany, passing rolling vineyards, lush forests, and charming medieval towns. In Wertheim, you'll discover a storybook-like old town with half-timbered houses, cobbled streets, and the imposing Wertheim Castle, perched high above the river with sweeping views of the surrounding area.

In Würzburg, prepare to be dazzled by Baroque grandeur and the warmth of Franconian hospitality. A visit to the Würzburg Residence, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, reveals majestic halls and Tiepolo’s famous fresco. Enjoy local wines and specialties in cozy wine taverns.

Another gem awaits in Miltenberg, where the romantic old town, the historic Schnatterloch Square, and the Old Town Hall evoke a sense of timelessness and charm.

Returning to Frankfurt, you’ll carry with you a treasure trove of unforgettable memories and rich impressions. This is the ideal blend of urban discovery and rural serenity – a river journey into the heart of Franconia that lingers long after it ends.

title: A Journey of Blossoms & Canal Romance
description: Your river cruise begins in Düsseldorf and takes you on a fascinating journey through some of the most charming cities along the Rhine and Dutch waterways. After departure, you arrive in Rotterdam, a vibrant harbor city, followed by Antwerp, where Flemish culture and splendid architecture await. The voyage continues to Middelburg and Veere, picturesque towns in Zeeland with maritime character. Next is Bruinisse, famous for its mussel fishing, before arriving in historic Willemstad. In Dordrecht, the oldest city in Holland, you’ll discover Dutch history, and Nijmegen, the Netherlands’ oldest city, offers a fitting finale. The journey ends back in Düsseldorf, full of memorable impressions.

title: Pure Culture Along The Seine
description:
Impressive architecture, enchanted gardens, picturesque villages, a blend of tradition and modernity – France brims with cultural highlights. Forget time and let your heart be captured – not only by the City of Love.

France offers a rich variety of experiences: From the majestic châteaux of the Loire Valley, steeped in royal history, to the vibrant streets of Marseille, where Mediterranean flair meets urban pulse. Discover the medieval towns of Provence, stroll through lavender fields, and indulge in the region’s aromatic cuisine.

The French coast is equally enchanting: Whether it's the glamorous French Riviera with its exclusive resorts like Nice and Cannes, or the raw beauty of the Atlantic coastline in Brittany – here you’ll find tranquility, adventure, and pleasure combined.

Cities like Lyon or Strasbourg showcase a harmonious blend of historical heritage and contemporary lifestyle. French cuisine, from rustic bistros to haute gastronomy, is an essential part of the journey – best enjoyed with a glass of Bordeaux or Burgundy wine.

France invites you to unwind, find inspiration, and embrace savoir-vivre in all its forms. Whether you're strolling romantically through Paris, relaxing along the Norman coast, or admiring half-timbered houses in Alsace – this journey will be unforgettable.

description:
Look forward to the included excursion: Koblenz City Walking Tour

 

Would you like to experience the true magic of the Christmas season, surrounded by festive splendor and culinary delights?

Experience the festive magic of winter on an enchanting Christmas journey from Düsseldorf via Koblenz and Speyer to Strasbourg, the “Christmas Capital of Europe.” Here, a traditional Christmas market awaits you with atmospheric lights, handmade crafts, and the tempting scent of cinnamon and roasted almonds.

Enjoy the romantic atmosphere with a glass of mulled wine, sample culinary specialties like tarte flambée or Baeckeoffe, and let yourself be enchanted by Alsatian charm. Another highlight is Rüdesheim, where the famous Drosselgasse glows with festive lights and spreads a joyful atmosphere.

This short trip combines Christmas magic, culinary delights, and unforgettable moments—perfect for experiencing the holidays in style and with festive spirit.

title: Rhine`s Short Welcome
description:
Autumn Getaway 2026

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €100 flight credit towards your journey. The credit applies to flights booked through VIVA Cruises.

 

Experience an enchanting short trip along the Rhine that takes you from Mainz to Düsseldorf. This route combines romantic river landscapes, cultural highlights, and the Rhineland’s zest for life into an unforgettable experience.

Your journey begins in Mainz, the city of printing, where the imposing St. Martin’s Cathedral and the lovingly restored Old Town invite you to linger. Stroll through narrow alleys and discover charming squares with cozy cafés.

The journey continues to Rüdesheim, where the famous Drosselgasse—surrounded by traditional wine taverns and picturesque vineyards—will enchant you. A ride on the cable car to the Niederwald Monument offers a magnificent view over the Rhine Valley.

In Koblenz, the spectacular Deutsches Eck awaits you, where the Rhine and Moselle rivers converge. Enjoy the view from Ehrenbreitstein Fortress, which you can reach by cable car.

Your journey continues to Bonn, Germany’s former federal capital. Discover the Beethoven House, stroll along the green Rhine promenade, and enjoy the peaceful, cosmopolitan atmosphere.

The grand finale is Düsseldorf—a city full of contrasts. Here, modern architecture, such as the MedienHafen, meets historic old-town alleys featuring the world’s longest bar. Discover contemporary art at the Kunstsammlung NRW or round off the evening in a cozy brewery.

This trip offers the perfect blend of history, nature, and urban flair—a true highlight for connoisseurs!

title: Rhone Reverie: Lyon
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Embark on a captivating journey along the Rhone River and discover the timeless beauty of Provence and beyond. Your voyage begins in Arles, a city rich in Roman history, with its impressive amphitheater, Provençal charm, and vibrant markets. Wander through the streets that once inspired Van Gogh, and immerse yourself in the region’s luminous atmosphere.

Next stop: Avignon, famous for the imposing Palace of the Popes and the iconic Pont d’Avignon. This city blends medieval splendor with cultural vitality and offers stunning views of the river.

In Viviers, step back in time as you stroll through its medieval alleys and discover its historic cathedral and atmospheric old town.

As the river winds onward, you'll reach Tournon and Macon, nestled among gentle vineyards, ancient castles, and peaceful countryside. Sample local wines and unwind amid serene natural settings.

Your journey culminates in Lyon, the gastronomic capital of France. Here, contemporary culture meets historic architecture. The old town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the traditional “Bouchons” offer an authentic taste of French cuisine.

This voyage along the Rhone seamlessly blends natural beauty, rich heritage, and culinary delights into an unforgettable experience.

title: Christmas Market Spree
description:
Would you like to experience the magical charm of the Christmas season in one of Europe’s most enchanting regions? Then let yourself be swept away by a festive short cruise along the Rhine, taking you to some of Germany’s finest Christmas markets.

Your journey begins in Düsseldorf, where the historic Christmas market welcomes you with sparkling lights, beautifully decorated stalls, and the comforting scent of mulled wine and roasted almonds. Stroll through the romantically lit old town, browse for handcrafted gifts, and soak in the festive spirit over a warm cup of cocoa.

The next stop is Bonn, where the Christmas market on Münsterplatz is set against the impressive backdrop of the Beethoven House. Here you’ll find festively adorned booths, a charming children’s carousel, and seasonal music performances that add to the joyful mood.

In Mainz, local delicacies like spiced cookies and artisanal cheeses tempt your palate, while regional artists offer handmade treasures for every taste. The market around the majestic cathedral is particularly atmospheric, its stunning silhouette adding a special touch to your festive experience.

Your visit to Koblenz completes the tour: the Christmas market in the picturesque old town stands out with its location at the Deutsches Eck, home to the monumental equestrian statue of Emperor Wilhelm I. Here, history and holiday cheer blend into a truly unforgettable experience.

After a day filled with seasonal wonders, you’ll return to Düsseldorf, where the festive memories will linger long after the journey ends. This cruise is the perfect getaway for anyone who wants to immerse themselves in the joy and anticipation of the Christmas season.

title: Douro: A Journey Along the Golden River
description: The journey begins in Porto, the vibrant city on the Atlantic. Colorful houses, baroque churches, and the famous port wine cellars set the scene. From the riverside, the views of Porto’s bridges offer a perfect introduction. The first stop is Leverinho, surrounded by terraced vineyards reaching down to the riverbanks. The UNESCO-listed Douro Valley unfolds in its beauty. In Folgosa, steep slopes and centuries-old vineyards dominate the landscape. The harmony between nature and wine culture is tangible. At Pocinho, the Upper Douro shows its wilder, quieter side: rolling hills, olive groves, and remote villages. From here, the ship sails to Vega Terron, at the Spanish border, where Portuguese and Spanish cultures meet. Returning via Pocinho, the cruise continues to Pinhão, considered the heart of port wine. Traditional wine estates, azulejo tiles at the station, and vine-clad hillsides enchant every visitor. In Régua, the wine capital of the Douro, museums and wine lodges tell the valley’s story while landscapes impress with grandeur. At Entre-os-Rios, where Douro and Tâmega meet, the scenery glows with vineyards, hills, and tranquil river views. The journey ends back in Porto, with lasting impressions of culture, wine, and stunning river landscapes.

title: Amsterdam to Basel: From Northern Waters to Mountain Majesty
description:
Experience an unforgettable river cruise through the heart of Europe!Your journey begins in Amsterdam, with its iconic canals and historic architecture. After another night in this vibrant city, the ship continues to Arnhem, known for its parks and the history of Operation Market Garden.

In Duisburg, a city shaped by industrial heritage, you’ll discover a fascinating blend of history and modern urban life. Upstream awaits Koblenz, where the Moselle flows into the Rhine, offering the perfect setting to explore the famous Deutsches Eck.

Next is Rüdesheim, a jewel of the Rheingau wine region, where you can stroll through the lively Drosselgasse. After another night here, the journey continues to Speyer, home to the impressive Imperial Cathedral and centuries of history.

In Kehl, you can enjoy the view of nearby Strasbourg, before reaching the final destination Basel in Switzerland – a city renowned for its art scene, museums, and unique position in the border triangle of France, Germany, and Switzerland.

This itinerary combines culture, history, and culinary delights, turning your river cruise into a truly memorable journey.

Discover romantic river landscapes, historic cities, and a relaxing onboard atmosphere while enjoying a varied wellness program with a Wellness Coach, inspiring health sessions, and soothing moments of relaxation.

Your journey begins in Düsseldorf before taking you to Boppard, where vineyards and charming historic streets invite you to unwind. In Speyer, explore the beautiful Old Town and enjoy inspiring health talks focused on holistic well-being.

Continue to Rüdesheim with its famous Drosselgasse before sailing through the breathtaking Loreley Passage in the UNESCO-listed Upper Middle Rhine Valley, surrounded by castles, vineyards, and spectacular scenery. Your final stop is Linz am Rhein, known for its colourful half-timbered houses and relaxed atmosphere.

Back in Düsseldorf, your wellness cruise concludes with lasting memories and renewed energy. Enjoy balanced Wellness Choice menus, a complimentary 30-minute massage, and a range of experiences designed to bring body and mind into harmony.

title: In Harmony with the Seine
description:
The journey begins in Paris, the “City of Light.” Strolling along the Champs-Élysées, gazing at the Eiffel Tower, or sipping coffee at a sidewalk café – nowhere is French lifestyle felt more intensely. Art, fashion, cuisine, and joie de vivre form the perfect introduction.

In La Roche-Guyon, the château nestled against the cliffs reflects rural elegance and historic charm.

Rouen welcomes travelers with its Gothic cathedral, immortalized by Monet, narrow medieval streets, and the legacy of Joan of Arc.

In Duclair, French gastronomy comes alive, with regional specialties like duck and cheeses that embody Normandy’s culinary richness.

Le Havre, a UNESCO site, offers maritime flair and modern architecture by Auguste Perret – a blend of creativity and French urban lifestyle.

Les Andelys impress with the imposing Château Gaillard, built by Richard the Lionheart, surrounded by serene Normandy landscapes.

In Vernon, half-timbered houses and proximity to Monet’s gardens in Giverny reveal the roots of French Impressionism.

Conflans-Sainte-Honorine, the capital of inland navigation, offers authentic charm and tranquility before returning to Paris.

The cruise ends in the city where French art de vivre shines brightest, with lasting impressions of culture, elegance, and lifestyle.

 

Look forward to your included VIVA Signature excursion – La Roche-Guyon: Echoes of the Castle

title: The Rhine, Unfiltered & Timeless
description: The cruise begins in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural capital, with its Gothic cathedral, medieval old town, and world-class museums. Next is Breisach, a charming town on the Upper Rhine, where St. Stephen’s Cathedral dominates the skyline and wine traditions invite exploration. In Strasbourg, French charm and German heritage combine. The stunning cathedral, “La Petite France,” and the European Parliament highlight the city’s unique role. The journey continues to Mannheim, known for its baroque palace, grid-style layout, and vibrant cultural scene. Rüdesheim, in the Rheingau wine region, delights with the lively Drosselgasse and panoramic views from the Niederwald Monument. In Koblenz, the Rhine and Moselle meet at the Deutsches Eck. The Ehrenbreitstein Fortress and the historic old town offer impressive sights and atmosphere. Cologne is dominated by its famous cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Museum Ludwig, old town, and lively promenade make the city unforgettable. Finally, Amsterdam provides the perfect finale, with canals, merchant houses, and cultural treasures such as the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum. A canal cruise reveals the city’s charm at its best.

    Experience a captivating Rhine journey from Düsseldorf to the vibrant cities of the Benelux, combining picturesque river scenery with culture, history and modern city life. title: Symphony Of Culture
description:
Experience the festive magic of the Danube on a magical Christmas trip that appeals to all the senses. From the imperial splendor of Vienna, with its magnificent palaces and atmospheric Christmas markets, the glittering river takes you through the wintry fairytale landscape of Austria. A Christmas world full of charm and tradition unfolds along the Danube.

In Dürnstein, an idyllic village in Wachau, romantic alleyways, baroque facades and the enticing aroma of gingerbread and mulled wine await you. Enjoy a stroll through the festively decorated town while the gentle sounds of Christmas carols waft through the alleyways.

Linz delights visitors with its festively illuminated main square, traditional Christmas stalls and culinary delights such as baked apples and hot chestnuts. A visit to the market of lights or a trip to the Ars Electronica Center offer additional highlights.

The Danube, framed by snow-covered hills and reflective fairy lights, leads you back to Vienna, where the magic of Advent shines in all its glory with music, arts and crafts and culinary specialties. Whether it's a visit to Schönbrunn Palace or an evening stroll through Rathausplatz - Vienna is at its most festive.

This trip is an unforgettable feast for the senses - a poetic celebration of the most wonderful time of the year that warms hearts and creates memories.

title: Treasures Of The Douro
description:
Experience the enchanting world of the Douro, where tradition, history, and natural beauty blend together in a truly captivating way. From Porto, the vibrant coastal city with its unique blend of historical heritage and modern flair, the Douro River winds its way through one of Europe’s most fascinating landscapes. Terraced vineyards nestled against the hills and picturesque, storybook-like villages define the landscape of this region, renowned for its world-famous port wine.

Immerse yourself in the rich culture of the Douro Valley, where centuries-old traditions are still alive today—especially in charming towns like Régua and Pinhão, which impress with their wineries, arts and crafts, and local cuisine. In Pocinho, the Douro reveals its wild and romantic side, surrounded by steep hills, unspoiled nature, and breathtaking views that invite you to linger and marvel.

Along the way, historic towns, ancient monasteries, Baroque churches, and authentic markets invite you to experience the Portuguese zest for life, culinary delights, and the warm hospitality of the locals.

Back in Porto, you’ll experience the region’s vibrant heart: a place brimming with life, music, architecture, and culture—the perfect conclusion to an unforgettable journey through the traditions, delights, and scenic beauty of the Douro Valley.

title: A Symphony of Tulips & Iconic Canals
description:
The river cruise begins in Düsseldorf, a city known for its lively old town, luxury shopping boulevard Königsallee, and vibrant riverside. After embarkation, the ship heads towards Amsterdam, the Dutch capital. With its canals, merchant houses, and world-famous museums such as the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum, the city offers a perfect mix of culture and charm. A canal cruise or walk through the city is an unforgettable highlight.

Next, the journey continues to Rotterdam, a city of striking modern architecture and Europe’s largest port. Highlights include the Market Hall, the Cube Houses, and the dynamic maritime atmosphere.

In Antwerp, travelers discover Belgium’s capital of diamonds and fashion. Famous for its Cathedral of Our Lady, the Grote Markt, and the Rubens House, the city blends historic splendor with cosmopolitan flair.

The following stop is Dordrecht, one of the oldest cities in the Netherlands. With canals, historic buildings, and a lively harbor, Dordrecht reflects Dutch heritage in a compact and charming way.

In Arnhem, guests encounter a mix of culture and nature. Known for the Hoge Veluwe National Park, the Kröller-Müller Museum with its Van Gogh collection, and its WWII history, the city offers depth and variety.

Finally, the ship returns to Düsseldorf, where the cruise ends but memories remain: a voyage rich in history, architecture, and unforgettable cities along the Rhine and Meuse.

title: Europe’s Timeless Lifeline
description:
The cruise begins in Vienna, where imperial splendor and musical heritage create the perfect prologue. St. Stephen’s Cathedral, Schönbrunn Palace, and the city’s café culture welcome visitors.

Next is Budapest, the “Pearl of the Danube,” with the Chain Bridge, Parliament, and Buda Castle.

In Batina, Croatia, guests enjoy tranquil villages and scenic river landscapes. The journey continues to Belgrade, Serbia’s vibrant capital, with Kalemegdan Fortress and a lively cityscape.

Rousse, Bulgaria’s “Little Vienna,” charms with neoclassical architecture. Stops in Fetesti and Harsova in Romania showcase authentic riverside life. Returning to Rousse, travelers once again savor its charm before heading to Svistov, marked by history and Orthodox churches.

Vidin impresses with Baba Vida Fortress, while Golubac boasts its dramatic fortress at the Iron Gates. Veliko Gradiste reflects Roman heritage and river traditions.

In Vukovar, Croatia, history meets renewal. Solt, Hungary, offers calm village life before the ship sails on.

Finally, Bratislava enchants with its old town, castle hill, and unique mix of tradition and modernity.

The journey ends back in Vienna, with memories of culture, landscapes, and history along the Danube.

title: The Waterways of Europe
description: This extraordinary journey combines the German capital with the Dutch metropolis of Amsterdam - a cruise full of diversity, history and scenic beauty. Your cruise begins in Berlin with impressions of the lively metropolis before gliding west through the Havelland region. Potsdam and Brandenburg an der Havel impress with their baroque architecture and Prussian heritage. Via Magdeburg and Haldensleben, the route continues along tranquil waterways to Hanover, Nienburg and Hoya - places where northern German serenity and historic old towns characterize the picture. In Bremen and Oldenburg, you will experience Hanseatic flair and maritime history before the ship crosses the Dutch border in Papenburg, Groningen and Franeker. The end of the journey in Amsterdam offers the perfect contrast: canals, culture and the unmistakable lifestyle of the Dutch capital make this an unforgettable moment.

title: The Essence of Paris
description:
Right in the heart of Paris, directly on the Seine, enjoy three nights filled with French charm, elegance, and tranquility. Your stylish retreat is securely moored along the riverbank and offers you a truly unique perspective on the city: In the morning, the water glistens in the sunlight as the first book vendors open their stalls. In the evening, the golden glow of the city lights is reflected in the gentle waves—with a view of the spires of Notre-Dame or the sparkling Eiffel Tower.

From here, you can explore Paris at a leisurely pace on foot—whether strolling through Le Marais, enjoying a café au lait on the riverbank, or having a picnic with a view of Île Saint-Louis. And those seeking tranquility will find it on the sun deck—accompanied by the sounds of the city and the gentle lapping of the Seine.

A Parisian getaway as wonderful as you could hope for: unhurried, stylish, and full of atmosphere.

 

Look forward to your included VIVA Signature excursion—Paris: To Montmartre in a Citroën

title: Danube Christmas Tales
description:
Look forward to the included excursion: Historic & Hearty Regensburg

 

Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Experience an enchanting Advent journey along the Danube, beginning in the historic city of Regensburg. The snow-covered Old Town, festively illuminated, exudes the true magic of the Christmas season in this charming Bavarian gem. Stroll through the romantic Christmas market in the courtyard of Thurn und Taxis Palace, where artisanal stalls, the scent of mulled wine, and Christmas music create an unforgettable atmosphere.

The journey continues to Passau, where the three rivers—the Danube, Inn, and Ilz—converge, and the Baroque Cathedral Square is bathed in warm light during Advent. In Linz, Upper Austria’s charming cultural city, festively decorated alleys, the scent of gingerbread, and the traditional Christmas market on the main square with regional specialties await you.

A special highlight is a visit to Melk, where the imposing Benedictine Abbey towers over the Danube like a shining landmark—a magical place, especially in the soft winter light. In Bratislava, with its snow-covered streets, you’ll feel like you’re in a real winter fairy tale.

The crowning finale of your journey is Vienna—the elegant capital with its imperial charm. Let yourself be enchanted by the magic of the Vienna Advent market on City Hall Square, enjoy classical concerts, and savor a slice of Sachertorte in one of the traditional coffeehouses. The magnificently decorated city center, artistic exhibitions, and warm atmosphere make Vienna the perfect backdrop for the end of the year.

This journey combines festive traditions, cultural highlights, and the romantic winter landscape of the Danube region into an unforgettable Advent experience.

title: Culinary Cruise France - Enjoy Normandy
description:
All the highlights at a glance: 
  • Exclusive wine pairings, curated by Master of Wine Romana Echensperger
  • Atmospheric entertainment featuring local artists on board
  • Private classical organ recital in the historic setting of Rouen
  • Guided tour through Rouen’s historic old town along the Vieux Marché
  • Paris: A ride in a Citroën to Montmartre
  • Visit to the Château de Chantilly with its unique art treasures and masterpieces
  • Tour of the Ferme des Ruelles—a charming 17th-century cider farm
An exclusive culinary journey through France

Experience France with all your senses—on our exclusive culinary journey departing from Paris in cooperation with our partner Falstaff. This special journey takes you to picturesque destinations along the Seine: from the capital, Paris, through Les Andelys, Rouen, Caudebec, and Conflans, and back to Paris.

Both on board and ashore, a true feast for the palate awaits you: enjoy exquisite tastings, themed samplings, and culinary highlights that bring together the best of French cuisine. Whether it’s fine wines, artisanal cheese specialties, or sophisticated menus—each stop brings new discoveries.

Travel through one of Europe’s most fascinating regions in a stylish setting and with the utmost comfort. Let yourself be inspired by the exclusivity of this culinary journey and experience France in a way you won’t soon forget.

title: New Year's Eve à la Seine
description:
New Year's Eve in Paris

 

Experience the New Year in a very special way: in style, in a relaxed atmosphere, and amidst one of Europe’s most beautiful cultural landscapes. Your journey begins in Paris, the City of Lights, where the ship becomes a festively decorated stage for an unforgettable winter cruise. The Seine takes you through rolling countryside, past castles, monasteries, and charming towns—all immersed in wintry tranquility and the French art of living.

The first stop is the picturesque town of Les Andelys, dominated by the ruins of Château Gaillard, which rises impressively above the Seine Valley. The journey continues to Rouen, the historic city of 100 church towers. Half-timbered houses, Gothic cathedrals, and cobblestone alleys tell stories of times long past. In Conflans, you’ll encounter tranquil riverside charm—a place perfect for a stroll along the water or a café crème in a small salon de thé.

Back in Paris, your journey reaches its glamorous climax: ringing in the New Year in the metropolis of elegance. The city pulsates in golden light, the boulevards glow with festive cheer, and the Eiffel Tower sparkles like fireworks in the sky. On board, a stylish New Year’s Eve awaits you, featuring a festive gala dinner, music, and champagne—a delightful farewell to the old year and an enchanting start to the new one.

This trip combines the best of both worlds: relaxing moments on the river amidst wintry landscapes and a New Year’s celebration in one of Europe’s most fascinating cities. Elegant, festive, and unforgettable.

 

Look forward to your included VIVA Signature excursion—Paris: To Montmartre in a Citroën

title: Xmas Bavaria
description:
Look forward to the included excursion: Wertheim—Stories from the Middle Ages

 

Experience the festive splendor of a Christmas journey along the Main and Danube rivers, where picturesque towns glow with festive lights and the scent of mulled wine and gingerbread fills the air. From Frankfurt, whose skyline sparkles in the winter light, the journey takes you through idyllic Wertheim with its snow-covered half-timbered houses, narrow alleys, and lovingly decorated stalls at the Christmas market.

In Würzburg, the Baroque old town welcomes you, framed by warm lights and the scent of cinnamon and roasted almonds. The magnificent Residenz, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, offers a fairytale backdrop for a stroll through the festively decorated streets. The journey continues to Nuremberg, where the world-famous Christkindlesmarkt entices visitors with its traditional atmosphere, handcrafted gifts, and culinary delights such as Nuremberg grilled sausages and Elisen gingerbread.

In Regensburg, one of Germany’s oldest cities, a medieval old town awaits you, aglow with Christmas splendor. Stroll through the romantic Advent market at Thurn und Taxis Castle, enjoy a glass of hot Feuerzangenbowle, or attend a festive concert in one of the magnificent churches.

This journey is a sensory exploration of the Christmas season, filled with contemplative moments, atmospheric music, and warm hospitality. Experience the magic of the holidays, set against historic backdrops and a winter wonderland—a getaway that creates memories to last a lifetime.

description:
For the third time, we’re inviting our most loyal guests to a very special event—the Ambassador Cruise 2026. This exclusive voyage is our way of thanking you for your long-standing loyalty and support. You are not just regular customers, but an essential part of the VIVA Cruises family—the heart of our success.

This year, an extraordinary highlight awaits you: For the first time, the Ambassador Cruise will take place aboard our ship, the VIVA BEYOND—the newest gem in our elegant VIVA Boutique line. Following its ceremonial christening in Paris in May 2026, the VIVA BEYOND will set sail for its maiden season, combining modern boutique design, a stylish atmosphere, and the highest level of comfort into an unparalleled travel experience.

For our valued Ambassador guests, we have designed a tailor-made program that is fully tailored to your wishes. Look forward to unique experiences, daily surprises on board, and special encounters that will make this journey unforgettable. You can also look forward to true culinary highlights—from exquisitely crafted gourmet menus to delightful moments that appeal to all the senses.

This journey is more than just a cruise—it’s a heartfelt thank you for your loyalty, a celebration of connections, and a tribute to our shared VIVA Spirit.

Experience the Ambassador Cruise 2026 aboard the VIVA BEYOND—exclusive, stylish, and unforgettable.

title: Wine, Castles & Timeless Tales
description: Discover the beauty of the Rhine and Moselle on this unforgettable river cruise. Starting in Düsseldorf, the journey takes you via Koblenz to the wine towns of Traben-Trarbach and Bernkastel, before reaching the historic Roman city of Trier. Explore picturesque Cochem and Treis-Karden, then continue to Rüdesheim and the legendary Loreley. With a final stop in Königswinter, you return relaxed to Düsseldorf. A perfect blend of culture, nature, and culinary delights!

title: Christmas Lights On The Danube
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey. For the following departure: 6–11 December 2026.

 

Join us on an unforgettable river cruise along the Danube, where picturesque landscapes, cities steeped in history and cultural highlights come together in harmony. Your journey begins in the imperial metropolis Vienna, where magnificent palaces, splendid boulevards and the sounds of classical music characterize the atmosphere. Enjoy a stroll through the historic old town or sample a slice of Sachertorte in a traditional coffee house.

On board, your comfortable ship glides through gentle bends in the river to Linz, a city characterized by its modern art scene, the Ars Electronica Center and baroque architecture. The past and future merge here in a fascinating way.

The journey continues to the three-river city of Passau, where the Danube, Inn and Ilz rivers meet. Admire the imposing St. Stephen's Cathedral with the largest cathedral organ in the world or stroll through narrow streets full of charm. In Regensburg, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, an architectural gem awaits you: well-preserved medieval buildings, narrow streets and the impressive Stone Bridge over the Danube.

Finally, you reach Nuremberg, a city full of historical significance, known for its old town with the imposing Imperial Castle, the Toy Museum and its role in world history. The mixture of half-timbered romance and historical depth gives the city its very special charm.

This river cruise is a symphony of culture, nature and enjoyment. Relax on board, take in the passing landscapes and discover the cultural treasures of Central Europe on shore excursions.

title: Timeless Journey Through the Lagoon
description:
The Essence of La Dolce Vita

This river cruise is a tribute to the beauty, elegance, and diversity of northern Italy. From the very first panoramic journey through the Venetian Lagoon to the final espresso at the Rialto Market, you will experience unforgettable impressions of art, culture, and the Italian way of life.

Your route takes you to the dazzling lagoon city of Venice, where history and modern life meet in magnificent palazzi, Renaissance masterpieces, and vibrant districts such as Dorsoduro. On the islands of the lagoon, you will discover colorful houses, traditional craftsmanship, and authentic island life – from Murano with its legendary glass art to Burano with its fine lace tradition.

The Italian lifestyle reveals itself in many ways: while strolling through the colorful alleys of Burano, exploring Murano with its world-famous glass art, or experiencing the authentic charm of Chioggia – often called the “Little Venice.” Cultural highlights such as the splendid villas of the region or the Renaissance palace of Castello del Catajo bring history vividly to life, while boutiques, small cafés, and lively markets reflect the modern Italian lifestyle.

On board the VIVA UNIQUE, you will enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of your ship as the lagoon landscapes drift by. This journey strikes the perfect balance between inspiring culture, authentic encounters, and the unmistakable dolce vita.

title: A Journey from the Capital to the Coast, Framed by Kiel Sailing Week
description: This extraordinary river cruise combines the fresh breeze of the Baltic Sea with the vibrant capital of Berlin and takes you along particularly tranquil stretches of rivers and canals through the heart of northern Germany. Your journey begins in Kiel, where Baltic Sea charm, sailing tradition, and an international lifestyle come together—especially during Kiel Week, the world’s largest sailing event, which promises a unique experience.From there, the journey continues to Hamburg, where the maritime heart of the Hanseatic city awaits you with its world-famous harbor, the Elbphilharmonie, and the lively Speicherstadt. The journey then continues along impressive waterways toward Scharnebeck. Here, you’ll experience the imposing ship lift—one of the tallest of its kind in Europe—a fascinating technical spectacle and a striking testament to German engineering.As you continue on your way, towns such as Uelzen, Calvörde, and Haldensleben offer glimpses of the peaceful, unspoiled countryside of northern Germany, far from the major cities. You’ll glide leisurely through diverse river and canal landscapes, enjoying the tranquil atmosphere along the route.Traveling along the idyllic Havel River, you’ll eventually reach Potsdam, whose magnificent palaces and sprawling gardens are designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Berlin serves as the crowning finale of your journey. Here, history, culture, and modern city life converge, ensuring a varied and memorable conclusion to this special journey between the Baltic Sea and the capital.

title: Jazz Cruise on the Moselle
description:
Embark on an unforgettable musical journey filled with elegance and indulgence. Our exclusive Jazz River Cruise combines the most beautiful landscapes along the Rhine and Moselle with atmospheric evening concerts on board featuring star pianist Frank Muschalle – a true feast for your eyes, ears, and soul. Each evening, the VIVA ONE transforms into an exclusive jazz club. Enjoy inspiring concerts on board – from swinging rhythms to soulful improvisations. The unique combination of river idyll, fine cuisine, and musical enjoyment makes this journey truly one of a kind.

Your voyage begins in Düsseldorf and takes you first to Koblenz, where the Rhine and Moselle meet. Through the idyllic Moselle Valley, the journey continues to Traben-Trarbach and Bernkastel, renowned for their famous vineyards, before reaching Trier, Germany’s oldest city. Afterwards, discover the picturesque towns of Cochem and Treis-Karden, before returning to the Rhine and charming Rüdesheim. A special highlight awaits with the impressive Loreley Passage, before the cruise takes you via Königswinter back to Düsseldorf.

title: Enchantment on the IJsselmeer
description:
The river cruise starts in Düsseldorf, where the lively old town, the elegant Königsallee, and modern riverside architecture provide a vibrant beginning.

In Amsterdam, the Dutch capital, canals, merchant houses, and world-class museums like the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum offer unforgettable experiences. A canal cruise or a stroll through the Jordaan district is a must.

The journey continues to Enkhuizen, a picturesque harbor town on the IJsselmeer. The Zuiderzee Museum and historic city walls tell the story of Dutch seafaring.

Next is Rotterdam, a city of bold architecture and Europe’s largest port. The Market Hall, Cube Houses, and the Erasmus Bridge highlight its modern character.

In Antwerp, Belgium’s diamond and fashion capital, visitors enjoy the Grote Markt, the Cathedral of Our Lady, and the Rubens House.

Willemstad enchants with its star-shaped fortifications and cozy harbor atmosphere.

The cruise then reaches Dordrecht, the oldest city in the Netherlands, with canals, historic buildings, and a vibrant waterfront.

In Arnhem, culture and nature combine. Known for its WWII history, the city also offers the Kröller-Müller Museum and the Hoge Veluwe National Park.

The journey concludes back in Düsseldorf, rich in memories of culture, history, and modern life.

title: Berlin Intense
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Immerse yourself in the vibrant diversity of Berlin and its charming surroundings on this unique river trip, which combines historical experiences and natural recreation in a fascinating way. The route begins on the lively banks of the Spree, where modern architecture and historic buildings offer an exciting interplay. 

Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, the journey continues to places steeped in history such as Oranienburg, known for its baroque palace and the moving Sachsenhausen memorial. Here you can enjoy the tranquil beauty of the river landscapes, which are characterized by dense forests, charming villages and small landing stages - ideal for relaxing walks or individual excursions.

A stay in Potsdam, whose magnificent cultural landscape with UNESCO World Heritage Sites such as Sanssouci Palace or the New Palace, is a particular highlight. Let yourself be enchanted by the architectural diversity, Prussian history and extensive gardens.

This trip is perfect for anyone who wants to experience the soul of Berlin intensively and discover the idyllic water world of Brandenburg at the same time. Whether on deck with a glass of wine, on a city tour or during a cycle tour along the river - the combination of urban dynamism and tranquil nature promises unforgettable moments with a pinch of water romance.
