title: The Timeless Elegance of Normandy
description:
For four nights, your floating boutique hotel will glide through one of France’s most historic and beautiful regions—from the stylish metropolis of Paris deep into the green heart of Normandy. This journey combines urban flair with the tranquil power of the water, artistic architecture with unspoiled landscapes, and the French joie de vivre with moments of tranquility.

The journey begins in Paris—sophisticated, vibrant, and rich in culture. From here, the route first takes you to Poissy, where royal history meets modern architecture. The silhouette of the Villa Savoye—a masterpiece by Le Corbusier—is reflected in the calm water, while your gaze wanders over green banks.

Further downstream, you’ll reach Rouen, the medieval city of 100 church towers. Half-timbered houses, cobblestone alleys, and Monet’s imposing cathedral create a backdrop straight out of a painting. Here, history meets you at every turn—from Joan of Arc to the Normandy of the dukes.

Another highlight awaits you in Les Andelys, picturesquely nestled in a bend of the Seine. Towering high above the town are the mighty ruins of Château Gaillard, once built by Richard the Lionheart. The view over the valley is spectacular—a place where nature, history, and romance come together.

Back in Paris, your journey ends where it began—with new impressions, enriched by the tranquility of the river and the magic of Normandy. This cruise is not just a journey through France, but a journey through time, style, and atmosphere.

 

Look forward to your included VIVA Signature excursion—Rouen: Macaron Workshop in Rouen

description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Experience the magic of the Advent season on a winter river cruise along the Rhine and Moselle. Starting in Düsseldorf, this festive journey takes you to some of the most charming towns in the region. In Koblenz, where the Rhine and Moselle meet, a historic old town awaits with a warm Christmas atmosphere. Further along the Moselle, discover the romantic wine towns of Bernkastel-Kues, Traben-Trarbach, and Cochem, where half-timbered houses and charming Christmas markets sparkle in festive lights.

Back on the Rhine, visit famous Rüdesheim, enjoy winter views of the vineyards, and soak up the seasonal atmosphere in Königswinter and Bonn. Everywhere, decorated streets, regional specialties, and the scent of mulled wine invite you to linger.

Relax on board as your ship comfortably brings you back to Düsseldorf - a perfect winter escape filled with festive charm and scenic landscapes.

title: Basel to Amsterdam: Alps to Canals
description:
The cruise begins in Basel, where Switzerland reveals its cultural richness. The Gothic cathedral, modern museums, and charming old town frame the serene flow of the Rhine.

The first stop is Breisach, a picturesque town on the Upper Rhine. St. Stephen’s Cathedral rises above vineyards and the rolling hills of the Kaiserstuhl.

In Strasbourg, French elegance meets German tradition. The magnificent cathedral, the canals of “La Petite France,” and timber-framed houses create a unique atmosphere in the Alsace region.

Sailing north, the ship reaches Mannheim, where the Rhine borders the city of squares, with its vast baroque palace and modern architecture.

A highlight is Rüdesheim, set among steep vineyards of the Rheingau. The lively Drosselgasse offers wine and music, while the cable car to the Niederwald Monument provides panoramic views of the Rhine Valley.

In Koblenz, the Moselle joins the Rhine at the Deutsches Eck, overlooked by the Ehrenbreitstein Fortress. The scenery of rivers and vineyards is breathtaking.

Cologne impresses with its iconic Gothic cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The old town, riverside promenade, and the Hohenzollern Bridge define the city’s vibrant skyline.

Finally, the Rhine broadens into lowlands on the way to Amsterdam. Canals, merchant houses, and world-class museums await. A canal cruise under evening lights offers the perfect finale to this cultural and scenic journey.

title: From Vienna to Budapest
description:
Experience a memorable river cruise along the Danube, connecting some of Central Europe's most fascinating cities and scenic landscapes. Your journey begins in Vienna, where an overnight stay gives you the opportunity to explore Austria's elegant capital and enjoy its unique atmosphere well into the evening.

Cruise through the picturesque Wachau Valley to the charming town of Dürnstein before visiting the impressive Melk Abbey and the vibrant city of Linz. Continue to Bratislava, where historic streets meet modern city life, and discover Komárno, a destination known for its rich history and remarkable fortress.

The highlight of your journey awaits in Budapest, where two overnight stays allow you to explore the Hungarian capital at a relaxed pace. Admire its iconic landmarks, stroll along the banks of the Danube, and experience the city's beautiful illuminated skyline after dark. Combining cultural highlights, historic towns, and breathtaking river scenery, this cruise offers a perfect way to discover the beauty of the Danube.

title: A Journey of Diamonds and Cathedrals
description:
The cruise begins in Düsseldorf, a city that combines tradition and modernity. The lively old town, also known as the "longest bar in the world", the elegant Königsallee and the modern buildings on the banks of the Rhine set the perfect mood for the cruise.

From here, we travel down the Rhine to Antwerp, one of the most fascinating port cities in Europe. The Belgian metropolis is famous for its role in the diamond trade, its fashion and art scene and the magnificent Grote Markt. The Cathedral of Our Lady with masterpieces by Rubens, the picturesque alleyways and the international harbor flair make Antwerp an unforgettable experience.

The next stop is Brussels, the capital of Belgium and the heart of Europe. In addition to the magnificent buildings of the EU institutions, the city enchants with the Grand-Place, one of the most beautiful squares in the world. Famous landmarks such as the Atomium or the Manneken Pis as well as culinary delights - from pralines to beer - make Brussels a highlight of the trip.

Back in the Netherlands, the ship reaches Nijmegen, the oldest city in the country. Situated on the banks of the Waal, it boasts historic churches, Roman remains and a lively city center with cosy cafés. The combination of history and student dynamism gives the city a special charm.

Finally, the ship returns to Düsseldorf. The journey ends here, but the memory of international culture, history and joie de vivre along the Rhine and Meuse remains.

title: From Riverbanks to the Baltic Sea, Featuring Kiel Sailing Week
description:

This extraordinary river and coastal journey begins in Berlin, the German capital, where urban life, history, and waterways blend in a unique way. From here, you’ll glide leisurely along the Havel River through a diverse landscape of lakes, canals, and green riverbanks. In Potsdam, an impressive blend of Prussian history, magnificent palaces, and sprawling parks awaits you, inviting you to explore and linger.

The route continues through tranquil waterways to Calvörde, where the serenity of the Mittelland Canal and the leisurely pace of travel take center stage. Here, you’ll experience the tranquil side of travel away from major cities.

A highlight that combines engineering and scenic beauty awaits you in Scharnebeck: the impressive ship lift, one of the largest of its kind in Europe, is a fascinating testament to German engineering. You’ll then reach the picturesque town of Lauenburg on the Elbe, whose historic half-timbered houses and steep alleyways give this Elbe town its special charm.

Traveling along the majestic Elbe, you’ll finally arrive in Hamburg, the “Gateway to the World.” Here, maritime flair, Hanseatic tradition, and modern metropolitan life blend into an unparalleled urban experience—from the bustling harbor to the elegant Speicherstadt.

The crowning finale is Kiel, where your journey ends during Kiel Week, the world’s largest sailing event. During this time, the city transforms into a lively festival district brimming with an international atmosphere, the romance of sailing, and North German joie de vivre. An unforgettable finale that perfectly rounds out this journey—a journey that harmoniously blends waterways, culture, technology, and a maritime way of life.

title: Europe in Concert: A Journey of Three Rivers
description: The river cruise begins in Amsterdam, the Dutch capital with its canals, merchant houses, and world-class museums. Heading upriver, Cologne awaits with its Gothic cathedral, old town, and vibrant riverfront. In Koblenz, the Rhine and Moselle meet at the Deutsches Eck, surrounded by vineyards and castles. Mainz enchants with its cathedral, half-timbered houses, and scenic wine country. Wertheim, framed by Spessart and Odenwald hills, offers a ruined castle above the picturesque old town. In Würzburg, the baroque Residence and Franconian vineyards stand out. Bamberg, built on seven hills, charms with its cathedral, timbered houses, and waterways. Nuremberg impresses with medieval walls, the Imperial Castle, and rich history. In Regensburg, the Stone Bridge and Gothic cathedral crown a beautiful Danube setting. Passau, at the confluence of three rivers, delights with baroque architecture. Melk presents its famous abbey overlooking the Wachau, a valley of vineyards and villages. Vienna welcomes with imperial palaces, music, and café culture. In Bratislava, a medieval old town and castle rise above the Danube. Finally, Budapest dazzles with Buda Castle, Parliament, and the Chain Bridge – a grand finale on the Danube.

Discover the magic of the Danube on an enchanting journey that starts from Vienna, the imperial capital of Austria, and takes you through some of the most beautiful places along the river. The splendor of Vienna - with its magnificent palaces, classical music tradition and cultural flair - is the perfect start to a river journey that promises both relaxation and discovery.

The journey continues to Budapest, the "Pearl of the Danube". Here you can expect an impressive mix of historical architecture, such as the parliament, the thermal baths and the imposing Fishermen's Bastion, as well as a lively coffee house culture. In Bratislava, the charming capital of Slovakia, you will experience an enchanting old town flair, characterized by baroque palaces, medieval alleys and the castle high above the Danube.

Back in Austria, the Danube reveals all its natural and cultural beauty. The picturesque Dürnstein with its famous castle ruins, where Richard the Lionheart was once imprisoned, offers a fairytale sight. Further downstream, the magnificent Melk Abbey, a jewel of Baroque architecture that towers majestically over the river, awaits you. In Linz, a city that combines tradition and modernity, you can experience contemporary art, digital culture and the warmth of Upper Austria.

The crowning finale is the return to Vienna, where the Danube and the Alps show Austria in all its diversity. This trip is a declaration of love to the beauty of Europe - a harmonious combination of nature, history and culture.

title: Jazz cruise on the Rhine
description:
Experience a special river cruise along the Rhine, where music, culture and spectacular scenery come together to create an unforgettable journey. Travelling upstream from Düsseldorf, you will discover one of Europe’s most beautiful river landscapes. Setting the rhythm on board is Frank Muschalle, a renowned Boogie-Woogie and Blues pianist, who will accompany your journey with his distinctive sound.

In Boppard, the UNESCO World Heritage Upper Middle Rhine Valley awaits. Your journey continues to Speyer, with its impressive Imperial Cathedral and charming Old Town. In Rüdesheim, enjoy a vibrant blend of local wine culture, joie de vivre and memorable musical moments.

Another highlight is the passage of the legendary Loreley, surrounded by steep cliffs, vineyards and historic castles. Afterwards, discover the charming town of Linz am Rhein, known for its colourful half-timbered houses and picturesque lanes.

Music also takes centre stage on board: Frank Muschalle brings Boogie-Woogie, Blues and Jazz to life at the piano, creating an atmosphere that perfectly complements your relaxed journey along the Rhine. Look forward to stylish evenings, culinary highlights and exceptional live music, accompanied by ever-changing river views.

Your journey concludes back in Düsseldorf – leaving you with unforgettable impressions and perhaps a few new favourite melodies to take home.

title: Seine In A Blaze Of Light
description:
When Paris is aglow with the lights of the pre-Christmas season, a journey filled with festive moments and winter romance begins. On this 5-night cruise, you’ll experience the magic of Advent along the Seine—from the cosmopolitan city of Paris to the charming historic towns of Normandy.

The journey begins in Paris, where sparkling boulevards, fragrant pastry shops, and festively decorated storefronts set the Christmas mood. After your first night on board, you’ll travel upriver to Les Andelys, a charming little town with medieval charm, dominated by the imposing ruins of Château Gaillard. Strolls along the riverbank or through the narrow alleys let you experience winter at its finest.

The journey continues to Rouen, the historic capital of Normandy. Half-timbered houses, Gothic churches, and one of France’s most beautiful Christmas markets make this city a true highlight of your trip. Let yourself be enchanted by mulled wine, handicrafts, and French winter cuisine.

In Conflans-Sainte-Honorine, where the Seine and Oise rivers meet, you’ll experience authentic French small-town life during the Advent season. The town is a quiet retreat—ideal for reflecting on the memories of your journey.

The journey concludes once again in Paris—festive, elegant, and full of magic. Perhaps you’ll discover the perfect Christmas gift at Galeries Lafayette or enjoy one last view of the Eiffel Tower bathed in winter light.

This cruise combines picturesque landscapes with cultural richness and the unique atmosphere of French Christmas traditions—a travel experience that warms the heart and the senses.

 

Look forward to your included VIVA Signature Excursion—Paris: To Montmartre in a Citroën

title: Basel to Lorelei: A Voyage Through Rhine Myth & Beauty
description:
The river cruise starts in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural hub, known for its Gothic cathedral, world-class museums, and charming old town. As the ship sets off, the journey down the Rhine begins.

In Strasbourg, French charm and German heritage blend seamlessly. The stunning cathedral, the romantic “La Petite France,” and the European institutions make this city a true highlight of the cruise.

Next is Frankfurt am Main, where Germany’s financial center meets cultural richness. The skyline contrasts with the medieval Römer square and the vibrant Museum Embankment, offering both modernity and history.

In Speyer, travelers step back in time. The Imperial Cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, dominates the city, while the Technik Museum and lively promenade add variety to the visit.

The following stop is Breisach, with its hilltop cathedral, wine traditions, and views over the Kaiserstuhl vineyards.

Finally, the ship returns to Basel, where art, history, and international flair provide the perfect ending to a diverse and memorable cruise.

title: A Journey from Impressionism to Modernism
description:
The journey begins in Paris, the eternal city of art. Embark along the Seine, surrounded by landmarks such as the Louvre, the Musée d’Orsay, and the Eiffel Tower. Paris breathes centuries of artistic creation, from Gothic cathedrals to Impressionism and contemporary art.

In Vernon, the gateway to Giverny, travelers discover Monet’s world. His house and gardens, with the lily pond and Japanese bridge, are the living essence of Impressionism.

Le Havre, immortalized by Monet, presents bold modernity. Rebuilt by Auguste Perret after WWII, its architecture is UNESCO-listed. The MuMa Museum holds one of France’s richest Impressionist collections outside Paris.

Rouen enchants with its cathedral, painted in Monet’s famous series. The Musée des Beaux-Arts and the old town with half-timbered houses add to the city’s charm.

In Conflans, artists once found inspiration along the riverbanks. Pissarro and others captured the atmosphere; today galleries and studios keep the tradition alive.

Back in Paris, the cruise ends, but the impressions remain – a voyage through the living heritage of French art.

 

Look forward to your included VIVA Signature excursion – Conflans: Avers-sur-Oise "van Gogh"

title: Rhine Romance & Canal Charm
description:
The river cruise begins in Düsseldorf, a city where contemporary lifestyle blends seamlessly with tradition. The elegant Königsallee, the lively Old Town – often called the longest bar in the world – and the scenic Rhine promenade set the tone for the journey ahead. From here, the ship heads north to Amsterdam, the vibrant capital of the Netherlands. Famous for its picturesque canals, historic merchant houses and world-class museums such as the Rijksmuseum and the Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam captivates at every turn. A canal cruise or a stroll through the charming Jordaan district offers unforgettable impressions.

Continuing south, the itinerary reaches Rotterdam, a city defined by bold architecture and maritime spirit. Highlights include the futuristic Markthal, the striking Cube Houses and the iconic Erasmus Bridge, all reflecting the Netherlands’ innovative character. As Europe’s largest seaport, Rotterdam impresses with its dynamic, international atmosphere.

A true hidden gem awaits in Dordrecht, the oldest city in the Netherlands. Quaint canals, centuries-old warehouses and a charming historic centre with churches and market squares invite relaxed exploration. The journey then continues to Nijmegen, one of the country’s oldest cities, where Roman heritage meets a lively modern vibe. Landmarks such as the Grote Markt and St. Stevenskerk, combined with cosy cafés and a green riverside setting, give the city its distinctive appeal.

Finally, the ship returns to Düsseldorf, bringing an enriching journey to a close. From cultural capitals and cutting-edge architecture to historic harbour towns, this cruise offers a remarkable variety of experiences – rich in contrast and lasting impressions.

title: Winter Moments in the Netherlands and Belgium
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Experience the magic of winter on an atmospheric river cruise through Germany, the Netherlands, and Belgium. This special journey combines romantic cities, wintry landscapes, and relaxing moments on board into an unforgettable experience.

Your cruise begins in Düsseldorf, where you’ll be welcomed aboard. Shortly after setting sail, you’ll enjoy the peaceful atmosphere on the wintry Rhine. Passing idyllic riverside landscapes, you’ll reach Nijmegen, the oldest city in the Netherlands. Historic alleyways, cozy cafés, and festively decorated squares invite you to take a leisurely stroll.

The journey continues through the picturesque Maas-Waal Canal to Venlo. This charming Dutch city delights with its historic old town, small boutiques, and wintery charm. Your ship then sets course for Maastricht—one of the most beautiful cities in the Netherlands. Here, historic architecture, elegant squares, and a Burgundian way of life come together. Let yourself be enchanted by the city’s special atmosphere.

Another highlight awaits you during the cruise on the romantic Waal River. Enjoy the view of passing winter landscapes, small villages, and wide riverbanks from the sun deck or the panoramic lounge.

In Liège, you’ll experience Belgian hospitality and a city rich in history and culture. Especially in winter, this vibrant metropolis reveals its very own charm. Stroll along the festively lit streets or savor regional specialties.

After eventful days on board and ashore, you’ll finally return to Düsseldorf. This winter river cruise combines relaxation, enjoyment, and impressive cities along romantic waterways—perfect for a relaxing getaway during the cold season.

    Autumn Getaway

    Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €100 flight credit towards your journey. The credit applies to flights booked through VIVA Cruises. For the following departure: 14–17 December 2026.

     

    Experience an idyllic river cruise from Düsseldorf and discover the diverse beauty of the Rhine. During your journey, you will enjoy a relaxed atmosphere on board, accompanied by culinary delights and excellent service.

    The journey first takes you through the picturesque Rhineland to the charming city of Koblenz, where the Moselle and Rhine rivers meet in an impressive panorama. Take the opportunity to stroll through the historic old town or visit the Deutsches Eck, one of the city's most famous landmarks.

    Continue on to Königswinter, which impresses with the legendary Siebengebirge mountains. We particularly recommend a ride on the cog railroad up the Drachenfels, from where you can enjoy a breathtaking view over the Rhine Valley. Immerse yourself in a world full of legends and nature.

    A highlight of the trip is undoubtedly a visit to Cologne, one of the oldest cities in Germany. Cologne Cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a masterpiece of Gothic architecture, dominates the city's skyline. The lively old town and the banks of the Rhine invite you to explore and linger.

    After many unforgettable impressions, you will finally return to Düsseldorf refreshed and inspired. This trip combines culture, history, nature and enjoyment in perfect harmony - a cruise along one of the most beautiful rivers in Europe that you won't soon forget.

title: Budapest & the Danube in Perfect Harmony
description:
The journey begins in Budapest, the “Queen of the Danube.” With Buda Castle, the Parliament building, and the Chain Bridge, the cityscape along the river shines in grandeur. From the Fisherman’s Bastion, the panorama is unforgettable.

Sailing upstream, the cruise reaches Bratislava, nestled at the foot of the Carpathians. Its white castle dominates the skyline, while the old town charms with narrow streets, baroque palaces, and cozy cafés.

The Danube winds through meadows and gentle hills towards Melk, where the Benedictine Abbey rises majestically above the river. Surrounded by Wachau vineyards, it symbolizes Austria’s cultural landscape.

In Passau, the “City of Three Rivers,” the Danube meets the Inn and Ilz. St. Stephen’s Cathedral with its grand organ, colorful facades, and the surrounding hills create a picturesque setting.

Linz follows, a city blending history and innovation. The old town and modern landmarks like the Ars Electronica Center stand proudly by the river, framed by soft hills.

A highlight is Vienna, Austria’s capital. The Ringstrasse, Schönbrunn Palace, and St. Stephen’s Cathedral recall imperial times, while the Danube Island and Vienna Woods invite relaxation.

Finally, the cruise returns to Budapest, where the illuminated skyline along the river offers a magical finale to this journey rich in history, culture, and landscapes.

title: Captivating Cultural Treasures on the Rhine
description:
The journey begins in Düsseldorf, a city where modern architecture meets the lively old town and elegant Königsallee. Cruising upriver, the ship reaches Niederlahnstein, a charming town at the confluence of the Rhine and Lahn, with medieval castles and a romantic atmosphere.

A highlight is passing the legendary Loreley rock, which towers dramatically above the river and has inspired countless poets and musicians.

In Rüdesheim, guests discover the famous Drosselgasse, full of wine taverns, music, and joy. A cable car ride to the Niederwald Monument rewards with stunning Rhine views.

The next stop is Mannheim, the so-called “city of squares,” where a baroque palace, modern arts, and lively culture come together.

In Strasbourg, French elegance blends with German heritage. The picturesque “La Petite France,” the magnificent cathedral, and European institutions make it a highlight of the cruise.

Further south lies Breisach, a small town with vineyards, wine cellars, and a historic hilltop cathedral, serving as a gateway to the Kaiserstuhl wine region.

Finally, the ship arrives in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural capital. Famous for its art museums, the old town, and architectural landmarks, Basel offers a cosmopolitan finale to an unforgettable river cruise.

title: The Regal Rhine
description:
The journey begins in Amsterdam, the Dutch capital with its canals, historic merchant houses, and world-famous museums. Art, water, and history define the start of this diverse river cruise.

In Arnhem, culture and nature blend harmoniously. The city on the Lower Rhine is known for its proximity to the Hoge Veluwe National Park and the Kröller-Müller Museum, home to an impressive collection of Van Gogh’s works.

The voyage continues to Duisburg, a city that reflects both its industrial heritage and its modern, vibrant side – a true symbol of the Ruhr region.

In Koblenz, the Rhine and Moselle meet at the Deutsches Eck. The city enchants with its old town, the Ehrenbreitstein Fortress, and magnificent views over the river valley.

Rüdesheim, in the heart of the Rheingau, invites guests to experience its famous Drosselgasse and the warm hospitality of the region.

In Speyer, the imposing Imperial Cathedral – a UNESCO World Heritage Site – dominates the skyline, while the historic centre reflects centuries of culture and tradition.

Kehl, situated directly on the Rhine opposite Strasbourg, combines German authenticity with French charm. From here, the view of the Europe Bridge and the Strasbourg skyline symbolizes the meeting of two cultures.

The journey concludes in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural capital on the Rhine. The Gothic cathedral, renowned museums, and the picturesque old town mark the end of a voyage rich in culture and Rhine romance.

title: Wine, water & world cultural heritage
description:
The cruise begins in Amsterdam, with its charming canals, merchant houses, and world-class museums. Seen from the water, the city’s bridges and historic façades create a magical impression.

Heading up the Rhine, the ship reaches Cologne, where the iconic cathedral dominates the skyline. The old town and riverside reflect Rhineland cheer. In Koblenz, where the Rhine and Moselle meet, vineyards, castles, and the Ehrenbreitstein Fortress form a dramatic landscape.

Along the Moselle, Bernkastel enchants with half-timbered houses and Riesling slopes. Traben-Trarbach shines with Art Nouveau architecture and wine heritage, while Cochem is crowned by its fairy-tale Reichsburg.

In Niederlahnstein, at the confluence of Rhine and Lahn, tranquility and history combine. Next, Rüdesheim offers its lively Drosselgasse, music, and wine, along with sweeping views from the Niederwald Monument over the Rhine Valley.

Frankfurt surprises with its skyline, historic Römer square, and vibrant Museum Embankment. On the Main River, Wertheim welcomes visitors with medieval charm, while Würzburg impresses with its baroque Residence and vineyards.

The journey continues into Franconia: Bamberg, a UNESCO site, delights with its cathedral, Little Venice, and brewing culture. Finally, the cruise ends in Nuremberg, where the castle, medieval old town, and cultural heritage create a memorable finale.

title: Elegance Along the Seine
description:
The cruise begins in Paris, the city of love and gastronomy. From buttery croissants and café au lait in the morning to refined pastries and haute cuisine, Paris offers culinary delights at every corner.

In Les Andelys, a picturesque town dominated by Château Gaillard, guests enjoy regional specialties such as Normandy cheeses and apple cider.

Rouen, the city of a hundred spires, offers bustling markets with Camembert, Livarot, fresh fish, and apple tarts paired with a glass of Calvados.

The journey continues to Caudebec, where travelers can savor mussels, hearty meat dishes, and crisp local wines.

In Le Havre, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, maritime flavors take center stage: oysters, scallops, and fish soup highlight the region’s connection to the sea.

Vernon brings travelers closer to Monet’s Giverny, where markets brim with honey, cider, and freshly baked bread.

Back in Paris, the journey ends with a gourmet dinner on the Seine, perhaps aboard a Bateau Mouche under the shimmering lights of the Eiffel Tower. A cruise celebrating art, history, and French culinary excellence.

 

Look forward to your included VIVA Signature excursion – Les Andelys: Château Gaillard & farm Visit

title: A Journey Through World-Class Cities & Storybook Havens
description:
The river cruise begins in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural capital. With its Gothic cathedral, world-class museums, and charming old town, the city offers a refined and international atmosphere.

The next stop is Breisach, nestled on the Upper Rhine. Known for its hilltop St. Stephen’s Cathedral, winding alleys, and local wine traditions, it is also a gateway to the Kaiserstuhl and Alsace regions.

In Strasbourg, French elegance and German heritage blend seamlessly. The magnificent cathedral, the picturesque “La Petite France” quarter, and the presence of European institutions make this city a highlight.

Mannheim surprises with its grid-style layout, the impressive baroque palace, and a lively art scene. Here, history and modern culture go hand in hand.

In Rüdesheim, guests enjoy the famous Drosselgasse, alive with music, wine, and cheer. A cable car ride to the Niederwald Monument offers sweeping views of the Rhine Valley.

Koblenz welcomes travelers at the confluence of the Rhine and Moselle, marked by the monumental “Deutsches Eck” and the mighty Ehrenbreitstein Fortress.

Next is Cologne, with its awe-inspiring cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its old town, vibrant museums, and Rhineland charm ensure memorable moments.

The journey concludes in Amsterdam, a city of canals, merchant houses, and world-renowned museums like the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum. Whether on a canal cruise or wandering through the Jordaan, Amsterdam provides the perfect finale to a rich and diverse river journey.

title: A Journey from Prague’s Gothic Grace to Berlin’s Modern Edge
description: Go on an impressive journey from the golden city of Prague to the lively metropolis of Berlin. Along Moldova and Elbe, you will experience the full diversity of Central Europe - from baroque castles and medieval old towns to modern cultural centers. Your route takes you from Prague via Mělník and Litoměřice to Bad Schandau, where the bizarre rock formations of Saxon Switzerland are fascinating. In Dresden, baroque masterpieces such as the Zwinger and the Frauenkirche await you, while Meissen inspires with its porcelain tradition and Wittenberg with the legacy of Martin Luther. Via Dessau and Magdeburg, which surprises with its imposing architecture, you finally reach Potsdam - a city full of elegance and royal history - before your journey comes to a glamorous conclusion in Berlin. On board, you will enjoy the highest level of comfort, regional cuisine and inspiring insights into the history of the places you visit. This cruise combines culture, indulgence and relaxation - an unforgettable experience between Prague and Berlin.

title: The Flavors of Italy
description:
Culinary River Cruise through Italy

Welcome to a journey of indulgence and discovery along Italy’s waterways. Starting in Venice, you will explore the treasures of the lagoon city and beyond, while enjoying the comfort of the VIVA UNIQUE.

From vibrant markets and gondola rides in Venice to the colorful island world around Mazzorbo, the natural beauty of the Po Delta, and the culinary delights of Bologna, each day holds a new highlight. Fresh seafood at the market in Chioggia, pasta-making in Bologna, wine tastings at renowned estates, and the elegance of historic villas combine into a unique travel experience.

Throughout the voyage, you will enjoy not only the sights of northern Italy but also its authentic flavors: fish and seafood, handmade pasta, regional wines, and the unmistakable spirit of la dolce vita.

After a week filled with culinary discoveries, charming towns, and unforgettable moments, your journey concludes where it began: in the magical city of Venice. You will take home not only souvenirs but also the taste of Italy, colorful memories, and the lightness of Mediterranean living.

title: The Journey To Düsseldorf
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Set sail on a fascinating journey along the iconic Rhine River, where history, culture, and nature blend in the most captivating way. Your voyage begins in Basel, a city that enchants with its vibrant mix of art, architecture, and history. Wander through the old town, explore renowned museums like the Fondation Beyeler or the Kunstmuseum Basel, and soak in the cosmopolitan atmosphere.

Continue to Strasbourg, the heart of Europe, where picturesque timber-framed houses and the imposing Cathedral of Notre-Dame define the charm of this UNESCO World Heritage city. A stroll through the romantic district of La Petite France completes the experience.

In Mannheim, discover the unique dialogue between modernity and tradition – from the grand Baroque palace, one of Europe’s largest, to the city’s innovative grid layout and dynamic urban life.

As you cruise through the idyllic Rhine Valley, you’ll reach Rüdesheim, a charming town surrounded by vineyards, quaint alleys, and inviting taverns. The famous Drosselgasse offers lively evenings with local wine and traditional music.

In Königswinter, nestled at the foot of the mystical Siebengebirge hills, enjoy a tranquil escape. A trip to the Drachenfels, with its stunning panoramic views over the Rhine, is a true highlight.

Your journey concludes in Düsseldorf, a modern Rhine metropolis known for its arts scene, fashion, and Rhineland hospitality. Stroll along the Königsallee, the Rhine promenade, or explore the lively old town one last time.

This journey along the Rhine is a wonderful exploration of Europe’s most beautiful cities and landscapes, making every moment truly special.

title: Rhine Christmas Cruise
description:
Look forward to the included excursion: Discover Mainz

 

This eight-day river cruise on the Rhine and its tributaries combines stunning landscapes with historic cities and cultural highlights. The journey begins and ends in Düsseldorf, a vibrant Rhine metropolis featuring modern architecture and a historic old town. From there, the route first takes you to Niederlahnstein, idyllically situated on the Lahn River and surrounded by medieval castles. This is followed by the Loreley Passage, one of the most famous stretches of the Rhine, characterized by steep vineyards, narrow river bends, and the legendary rock formation.

In Mannheim, the focus is on visiting a modern metropolis with significant cultural institutions such as the palace and the art museum. Further south lies Strasbourg, the capital of Alsace and seat of the European Parliament. The old town, with its imposing cathedral and half-timbered houses in the “La Petite France” district, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

On the return journey upstream, the ship reaches Rüdesheim, known for Drosselgasse, viticulture, and the romance of the Rhine. This is followed by an evening stop in Königswinter at the foot of the Drachenfels, a region steeped in legend and offering sweeping views over the Rhine Valley. Finally, the journey ends back in Düsseldorf, where disembarkation takes place after an overnight stay.

The cruise combines scenic attractions such as the romance of the Middle Rhine with cultural highlights ranging from German royal capitals to the French metropolis on the Rhine. It offers a cross-section of history, architecture, and wine culture along one of Europe’s most significant waterways.

Join us on a picturesque river cruise along the Rhine and Moselle, which takes you from Düsseldorf via Koblenz, Traben-Trarbach and Bernkastel to the historic city of Trier and then via Cochem, Treis-Karden, Rüdesheim and the Loreley Passage to Königswinter and back to Düsseldorf. This carefully curated itinerary combines impressive cultural treasures, breathtaking landscapes and authentic regional charm.

Your journey begins in the modern metropolis of Düsseldorf, where architecture, museums and the famous Königsallee with its elegant boutiques and cafés invite you to linger. You then glide along the Moselle, past gentle vineyards, picturesque half-timbered villages and steep slopes on which some of the best Riesling wines in Europe thrive. In Trier, the oldest city in Germany, you will experience an impressive foray into Roman history: the Porta Nigra, the amphitheater and the Imperial Baths are just some of the fascinating sights.

The route then continues to Cochem, where the Reichsburg castle towers high above the town and offers a fairytale panorama. In Treis-Karden you can enjoy the special charm of the Moselle, while Rüdesheim attracts visitors with its famous Drosselgasse. This trip is a perfect combination of history, culture, nature and culinary delights - an experience that will live long in the memory.

title: The Island Jewel of the Netherlands
description:
The journey begins in Amsterdam, the cosmopolitan capital of the Netherlands. Between picturesque canals, historic merchant houses, and world-famous museums such as the Rijksmuseum, the city exudes a unique charm. A canal cruise offers the perfect first impressions of the country’s beauty.

The ship then sets course for Enkhuizen, once a powerful port city on the IJsselmeer. Today, it enchants visitors with the Zuiderzee Museum and its well-preserved city walls. Its location right on the water evokes a sense of vastness and freedom. The voyage continues to Harlingen, a historic port town full of North Holland charm. Here, guests experience the close connection between seafaring and history. From the promenade, the view stretches far across the Wadden Sea, while the old town, with its canals and warehouses, invites exploration.

In Lelystad, at the heart of the Flevoland region, the Dutch art of land reclamation comes to life. The Batavialand Museum and the reconstructed sailing ship Batavia recall the country’s great maritime past. Next stop is Utrecht, where the Dom Tower rises majestically above the city. Along the canals, with their characteristic wharves below street level, unfolds a unique urban scenery lined with cafés, boutiques, and historic warehouses.

In Dordrecht, the oldest city in the Netherlands, visitors encounter a rich trading history. Historic canal houses and the impressive Grote Kerk shape the skyline, surrounded by rivers and waterways. Finally, the ship reaches Rotterdam, the modern port metropolis. Futuristic architecture such as the Markthal and the Cube Houses, along with Europe’s largest harbor, reflect the city’s energy and innovative spirit. Back in Amsterdam, the cruise concludes—with unforgettable impressions of waterways, historic towns, and contemporary urban life.

title: Austria's New Year
description:
Welcome the New Year with us in Vienna!

 

Experience New Year’s Eve in a truly special way as you cruise gently along the Danube and discover some of Europe’s most fascinating cities. Your journey begins in Regensburg, a city full of medieval charm, winding lanes and festive atmosphere. Stroll through the historic old town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, before continuing to Passau.

In the City of Three Rivers, magnificent architecture, picturesque streets and the unique meeting point of the Danube, Inn and Ilz await you. From there, your journey continues to Linz, Austria’s vibrant city of culture, with its lively music scene and cultural highlights.

Next, you travel to Vienna, where you will celebrate the turn of the year in a wonderfully festive setting. Discover the city of music, art and imperial elegance. With its beautifully decorated centre and unique New Year’s atmosphere, Vienna is the perfect place to welcome the year ahead.

In Budapest, impressive architecture, historic thermal baths and wonderful views of the Danube await. Afterwards, explore Bratislava with its charming old town, narrow lanes and distinctive atmosphere.

To round off your journey, you return once more to Vienna. This cruise combines culture, history, festive spirit and relaxing moments on board – an unforgettable way to start the New Year.

Experience an enchanting journey along the Moselle, which takes you from Koblenz via picturesque wine villages back to the royal city. The Moselle, one of the most beautiful rivers in Germany, meanders through a breathtaking landscape of rolling hills, magnificent vineyards and medieval castles that seem straight out of a fairy tale.

In Traben-Trarbach, once one of the most important wine trading towns in Europe, you will encounter a place full of Art Nouveau architecture, elegant riverside promenades and historic charm. The town invites you to take a leisurely stroll through its history. Continue to Bernkastel-Kues, which impresses with its winding alleyways, romantic half-timbered houses and traditional wineries. Here you can enjoy the Moselle with all your senses - with a glass of regional Riesling, a walk along the banks or a visit to the historic castle ruins.

In Cochem, one of the highlights of the trip, the majestic Reichsburg Castle rises high above the river valley. From here, you can enjoy an unforgettable panoramic view of the surrounding vineyards and the historic old town, which invites you to linger with its small cafés, wine taverns and boutiques.

This trip along the Moselle combines nature, history and wine in perfect harmony. It is a feast for the senses, an immersion in the soul of a region rich in culture and warmth. Whether on a romantic boat trip, a hike through the vineyards or enjoying local specialties - this trip will remain unforgettable.

title: Danube City Collection
description:
This Danube cruise combines the most beautiful cities on the Middle Danube with additional time to enjoy. Vienna is the stylish prelude: Imperial architecture, world-famous sights and the special coffee house culture invite you to discover the city at your leisure. The longer stay leaves room for relaxed walks, cultural highlights and the real Viennese way of life.

Down the Danube, the ship reaches Budapest, one of Europe's most impressive metropolises. The majestic backdrop of the castle district, parliament and illuminated bridges unfolds its magic especially in the evening. Thanks to the more intensive itinerary, there is more time to get to know both districts - Buda and Pest - and soak up the special flair of the Hungarian capital.

In Bratislava, the Danube shows its charming side. The compact old town with its historic alleyways, cozy cafés and the castle perched high above the river is a relaxing place to explore. The view over the Danube and the surrounding countryside rounds off your stay.

Finally, the ship returns to Vienna. The journey ends with the feeling that you have not only traveled the Danube, but really experienced it: three fascinating cities, more time per destination and a harmonious balance of culture, enjoyment and relaxation - a Danube cruise with depth.

title: The Beauty of Austria
description:
The river cruise begins in Vienna, Austria’s imperial capital. Palaces such as Schönbrunn and the Hofburg, the Ringstrasse, and the famous St. Stephen’s Cathedral reflect grandeur, while coffeehouses and music breathe life into the city.

The first stop is Vác in Hungary, a charming town with baroque churches, a lively square, and a relaxed riverside atmosphere.

Next is Budapest, Hungary’s dazzling capital. Highlights include the Parliament, the Fisherman’s Bastion, and the Chain Bridge. Buda offers its castle on the hill, while Pest features boulevards, cafés, and thermal baths.

In Bratislava, Slovakia’s capital, the castle overlooks the old town, full of palaces, narrow alleys, and relaxed flair. The view over the Danube is unforgettable.

The journey continues to Melk, famed for its baroque abbey above the Wachau Valley. Its ornate halls, library, and location among vineyards make it a jewel of the Danube.

In Linz, Austria’s cultural hub, tradition and innovation meet. The baroque main square, the Lentos Art Museum, and the Ars Electronica Center showcase both history and modern creativity.

Finally, the ship returns to Vienna, where the cruise concludes with memories of culture, history, and breathtaking landscapes along the Danube.

description:
Experience an extraordinary river cruise that takes you from Düsseldorf through charming Dutch cities to the picturesque islands in the north. After departing from Düsseldorf, the lively university town of Nijmegen awaits before the journey continues to the vibrant capital, Amsterdam. With two overnights in the city, there is plenty of time to stroll along its iconic canals, visit world-famous museums, or simply enjoy the colorful urban atmosphere.

A true highlight is the visit to Harlingen and Oudeschild on the island of Texel – a paradise of dunes, beaches, and authentic island life. Explore the landscape by bike, spot seals, or taste fresh local specialties straight from the sea.

Back on the mainland, Enkhuizen welcomes you with its maritime charm and living history, before the journey continues to Utrecht, a city rich in culture, Gothic architecture, and cozy canal cafés.

The cruise concludes back in Düsseldorf, leaving you with lasting memories of serene waterways, cultural treasures, and the unique Dutch joie de vivre. A route that beautifully combines maritime history, urban diversity, and pure relaxation.

description:

Join us on a fascinating river cruise along the Danube, which reveals the beauty and elegance of Central Europe in all its glory. From the imperial metropolis of Vienna, you glide through the gentle current of the river, past picturesque landscapes, until you reach Budapest, the pearl of the Danube - a city that boasts imposing architecture, historic bridges and unforgettable views.

On your way, you will discover Vac, a charming little town with baroque architecture and a lively market. In Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia, you will experience the perfect blend of history and modernity. Narrow streets, magnificent palaces and the impressive castle high above the Danube tell stories of past centuries.

During the trip, various shore excursions invite you to explore: Enjoy a wine tasting in the Danube floodplains, stroll through historic old towns or simply relax on board with panoramic views of the passing nature. You will be spoiled with regional specialties and international delicacies, accompanied by first-class on-board service.

Back in Vienna, you will experience the city in a new light - as the Danube lovingly flows around it and gives it a very special glow. Whether during a visit to Schönbrunn Palace, a concert at the Vienna Musikverein or a leisurely stroll along the Danube Island - this trip ends with cultural delights.

A cruise that combines culture, history, culinary delights and enchanting river landscapes in an impressive way - an unforgettable experience for all the senses.

title: The Rhine From Basel
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey. For the following departure: 3–8 October 2026.

 

Embark on an unforgettable journey along the majestic Rhine River, taking you through charming cities, historic landmarks, and picturesque landscapes. Your voyage begins in Basel, a city where the vibrant blend of art, history, and modern architecture creates a unique urban atmosphere. Stroll through the old town, visit the renowned Kunstmuseum Basel, or relax at a riverside café with stunning views.

Next, you’ll arrive in Strasbourg, the beating heart of Europe. Discover the winding alleyways, timber-framed houses, and the enchanting Petite France district, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Don’t miss the awe-inspiring Notre-Dame Cathedral, a masterpiece of Gothic architecture.

In Frankfurt, experience the dynamic interplay of tradition and innovation. The striking skyline, historic sites like the Römer, and the city's multicultural flair make it a compelling destination.

Speyer takes you back in time with its grand imperial cathedral, one of the largest Romanesque buildings in Europe, and a medieval old town full of charm.

Another gem is Breisach am Rhein, nestled beside the gentle hills of the Kaiserstuhl. The St. Stephen’s Cathedral offers a breathtaking view over the river and surrounding countryside. Enjoy a glass of local wine and soak in the warm hospitality.

This journey along the Rhine is a celebration of cultural diversity, history, and natural beauty – a true feast for the senses that will leave lasting memories.

title: Normandy's Winter Wonderland
description:
Look forward to your included VIVA Signature Excursion—Paris: To Montmartre in a Citroën

 

Spend the most festive time of the year in particularly stylish fashion—aboard an exclusive cruise from Paris through the wintry landscape along the Seine. For six nights, the ship will be your cozy home on the water, while outside, the banks of northern France transform into a glittering winter wonderland.

Paris welcomes you with the festive glow of the holidays: artfully decorated boulevards, sparkling storefronts, and the scent of roasted chestnuts set the mood for the days ahead. From here, the ship glides at a leisurely pace toward Normandy—a feast for the senses, accompanied by fine cuisine, festive music, and the warm glow on board.

In Poissy, the charming atmosphere of a small town awaits you, with its Gothic church and historic old town. Vernon enchants with its romantic half-timbered houses and Claude Monet’s famous home in nearby Giverny—a place of quiet beauty even in winter. Rouen, the proud city of a hundred church towers, shines during the Christmas season with a particularly festive market in front of the cathedral and winding alleys steeped in history. In Les Andelys, the panoramic view of the imposing Château Gaillard castle ruins unfolds before you—especially impressive on a frosty, clear day.

Back in Paris, you’ll celebrate Christmas Eve amidst the winter magic of this unique city. Enjoy a festive gala dinner, lights reflecting on the water, and a quiet, elegant night that will linger in your memory.

This Christmas journey combines the French way of life, historic settings, and contemplative moments—a cruise full of warmth, relaxation, and Christmas splendor.

title: Whispers Of The Rhone
description:
Experience an unforgettable journey along the Rhône River, taking you from Lyon, the gastronomic capital of France, into the picturesque landscapes of Provence. Discover the charming town of Touron, where quiet streets and typical Provençal architecture invite you to take relaxing strolls. In Avignon, the majestic Palace of the Popes awaits, offering a stunning glimpse into medieval history. Let the atmosphere of the city enchant you, with its vibrant squares, cozy cafés, and the famous Pont d’Avignon.

Arles captivates with its impressive Roman heritage – including a well-preserved amphitheatre – and its connection to Vincent van Gogh, who painted some of his most iconic works here. Continue to Viviers, a hidden gem of Provence, where the narrow medieval old town glows in warm golden light. Stroll through cobbled alleys lined with stately townhouses and visit the striking Cathedral of Saint-Vincent.

The Provence unfolds in full splendor with its gentle hills, vast lavender fields, and quaint villages like Gordes or Les Baux-de-Provence. The region is a feast for the senses – from the fragrance of herbs to the taste of fine wines and regional delicacies. This journey is a celebration of Southern France – an experience that awakens all your senses and touches the soul deeply.

title: Rhone Reverie: Arles
description:
Experience the captivating beauty of the Rhône on an unforgettable journey that harmoniously blends culture, nature, and the joie de vivre of southern France. Starting in Lyon, the vibrant capital of fine living, you’ll discover culinary highlights, a rich architectural heritage, and a lively atmosphere. Let yourself be captivated by the diversity of this city before the river carries you onward.

Glide through the rolling vineyards of Mâcon, past picturesque slopes famous for their fine wines. Enjoy a wine tasting in this region, which is renowned for its Burgundy wines. Further downstream, you’ll reach Tournon-sur-Rhône, a charming riverside town with an imposing castle and magnificent views of the surrounding countryside.

In Viviers, one of the oldest towns in France, you’ll be immersed in a fairy-tale-like tranquility. The historic facades and narrow streets tell stories of times long past and invite you to take a leisurely stroll.

A cultural highlight awaits you in Avignon, where the massive walls of the Papal Palace and the famous “Pont Saint-Bénézet” bridge reflect the splendor of medieval power. Stroll through the old town and discover the unique charm of this UNESCO World Heritage Site.

The crowning finale of your journey is Arles. The city captivates with its Roman past—including the well-preserved amphitheater—and an artistic atmosphere that once inspired Vincent van Gogh. Here, the Rhône River opens the gateway to Provence, a region brimming with fragrance, light, and color—a place that touches the heart and creates memories that last a lifetime.

title: Culinary Cruise Portugal - Wine & Pleasure on the Douro
description:
All Highlights at Glance

Overnight stay in a first-class hotel in the heart of Porto’s historic center before your river cruise begins

Guided city tour of Porto with a delightful sweet stop along the way

Behind-the-scenes visit to a traditional factory producing Portugal’s famous sardine preserves

Discovery of olive oil production at Quinta do Tourao, including an encounter with the rare native donkeys bred there

Visit to the elegant Mateus Manor House – a baroque masterpiece with refined rooms, a historic library, and idyllic gardens

Authentic wine experience at Quinta do Crasto, surrounded by the breathtaking vineyards of the Douro Valley

Tour of the historic Taylor’s cellars in Vila Nova de Gaia with an exclusive insight into the world of Port wine

An unforgettable signature evening at the magnificent Palácio da Bolsa in Porto – a night of true grandeur

Enjoyment of curated tastings featuring selected Douro winesFlavors along the Douro

Embark on a culinary journey through Portugal on board our exclusive Culinary Cruise from Porto together with our partner Falstaff. Following the majestic Douro River, this voyage takes you to Leverinho, Régua, Pocinho, Vega Terrón, Pinhão, Entre-os-Rios and finally back to Porto.

As you sail through one of Europe’s most celebrated wine regions, discover the authentic flavors of Portugal: from refined Port wine tastings at historic quintas to regional specialties that make this country so unique. On board, enjoy select tastings, carefully composed menus, and culinary experiences that capture the full diversity of Portuguese cuisine.

Travel in stylish comfort through the enchanting Douro Valley – a culinary cruise that brings together gastronomy, culture, and breathtaking landscapes in perfect harmony.

title: Crime Cruise to Düsseldorf
description: The cruise begins in Bremen, a Hanseatic city rich in history. The UNESCO-listed town hall and Roland statue, along with the famous Town Musicians, set the stage. Soon the ship glides onto the Weser, framed by green river meadows. The journey continues to Hoya, a former residence town with a castle, timber-framed houses, and quiet riverbanks. In Nienburg, colorful old houses and asparagus traditions shape the town’s charm. Minden is next, where the Weser meets the Mittelland Canal in a remarkable waterway crossing. Medieval churches and merchant houses add to the city’s appeal. The cruise proceeds to Münster, the city of towers and bicycles. The Prinzipalmarkt, Lambertikirche, and the lake Aasee highlight its blend of history and vibrant life. In Herne, the Ruhr area’s industrial past is visible, with parks, canals, and heritage sites marking the transformation of the region. Duisburg impresses with Europe’s largest inland port, a fascinating mix of bustling docks and natural Rhine floodplains. Finally, the ship reaches Düsseldorf, the stylish capital of the Rhineland. The Königsallee, Media Harbor, and the lively old town form the perfect finale to a journey filled with landscapes, history, and vibrant cityscapes.

title: Cultural Treasures & Gourmet Experiences on the Rhine
description:
The journey begins in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural capital, with its Gothic cathedral, renowned museums, and picturesque old town.

The first stop is Breisach, where St. Stephen’s Cathedral rises above the town and the region’s wine traditions invite exploration.

In Strasbourg, French elegance and German heritage meet. Highlights include the cathedral, “La Petite France,” and the city’s role as home to European institutions.

Mannheim impresses with its baroque palace and cultural vibrancy, while Mainz offers its famous cathedral, the Gutenberg Museum, and lively Rhine spirit.

In Rüdesheim, guests stroll through the Drosselgasse, full of wine and music, before enjoying sweeping views from the Niederwald Monument. Sailing past the legendary Loreley rock is an unforgettable highlight.

Niederlahnstein enchants with castles and narrow alleys at the confluence of the Rhine and Lahn. In Königswinter, a ride up the Drachenfels mountain offers spectacular vistas over the Rhine Valley.

Finally, the ship arrives in Düsseldorf, where modern architecture, the Königsallee, and a lively old town provide the perfect finale to a cruise rich in culture, history, and memories.

title: Brussels To Berlin: A European Journey
description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Your river cruise in October begins in Brussels. The Belgian capital enchants with magnificent façades, winding streets and the famous Grand Place. Soak up the unique atmosphere of this European metropolis before your ship sets course for the Netherlands.

In Utrecht, picturesque canals, historic merchant houses and the striking Dom Tower await. The journey then continues to Franeker, a charming Frisian town whose historic centre and relaxed atmosphere invite you to take a leisurely stroll. Groningen offers a fascinating contrast, combining historic architecture with the vibrant spirit of a lively university city.

During a relaxing day on the river, enjoy the comforts on board while watching the ever-changing scenery glide by. Back in Germany, you arrive in Duisburg-Ruhrort, a district shaped by the Rhine and its long maritime and harbour tradition.

Continue to Münster, renowned for its beautiful old town, Prinzipalmarkt and characteristic gabled houses. Minden also boasts a rich history and an attractive historic centre. Via Hanover and Calvörde, your cruise takes you eastwards to Brandenburg an der Havel, where waterways, historic buildings and idyllic riverbanks create a delightful setting.

Towards the end of your journey, discover Potsdam with its magnificent palaces and parks. From here, it is only a short distance to Berlin, where your varied river cruise through Belgian, Dutch and German landscapes comes to a memorable conclusion.

title: Vienna to Basel: A Fairytale in Summer Light
description:
The river cruise begins in Vienna, where imperial palaces, baroque architecture, and the Danube create a majestic atmosphere. From St. Stephen’s Cathedral to the Hofburg, the city radiates elegance.

Sailing through the Wachau valley, the ship reaches Dürnstein, surrounded by vineyards and castle ruins. The blue abbey tower is a landmark of romantic charm. In Melk, the grand Benedictine abbey rises above the Danube, a baroque masterpiece.

In Passau, at the confluence of the Danube, Inn, and Ilz, guests discover an Italianate old town and the cathedral with the world’s largest organ.

Regensburg offers a UNESCO-listed medieval old town with the Stone Bridge, patrician houses, and narrow alleys recalling its merchant past.

Nuremberg impresses with its Imperial Castle, half-timbered houses, and historic Reichstag sites. Then comes Bamberg, the “Franconian Rome,” built on seven hills, with cathedral, old town, and rivers weaving through.

In Würzburg, the Residenz Palace, a UNESCO site, dominates the baroque city, framed by vineyards and overlooked by the Marienberg Fortress. Wertheim charms with its castle ruins and riverside old town.

Frankfurt provides a striking contrast with its skyline, historic Römer square, and lively museum embankment.

Further along the Rhine, Ludwigshafen serves as a gateway to the Palatinate wine region. Strasbourg enchants with its cathedral, canals, and Franco-German flair.

Breisach delights with wine traditions and its hilltop cathedral, before the journey ends in Basel, a Swiss city of art, history, and international spirit, surrounded by the beauty of the Upper Rhine.

description:
Autumn Getaway

Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

 

Experience a fascinating river cruise that takes you through picturesque eastern Germany. On this unique journey from Potsdam to Dresden, you’ll discover enchanting cities such as Magdeburg, with its imposing cathedral and modern architecture, as well as Wittenberg, famous as the site where Martin Luther worked and the center of the Reformation. Another highlight is the charming town of Meissen, known worldwide for its porcelain artistry and the impressive Albrechtsburg Castle.

As you glide along the Elbe and, in some sections, the Vltava, you’ll be surrounded by rolling hills, lush forests, and expansive river landscapes. Nature shows itself at its most beautiful here—with romantic valleys, flower-filled riverbanks, and a variety of waterfowl. This cruise is not only a journey through space but also through time—past medieval castles, Baroque palaces, and historic old towns.

On board, you’ll enjoy the highest level of comfort, culinary highlights of the region, and a varied cultural program to enrich your evenings. Whether you join a guided city tour or stroll through narrow alleys on your own—every day offers new discoveries.

This journey reveals the true soul of Eastern Germany—an incomparable blend of history, culture, and nature that will remain in your memory for a long time to come.

title: A Journey of Wind, Water & Wonder
description:
The journey begins in Brussels, Belgium’s capital and the heart of Europe. The Grand Place, historic façades, and modern institutions create a lively atmosphere. Leaving the city, the landscape opens into meadows, forests, and rivers.

In Antwerp, the Cathedral of Our Lady dominates, while the Grote Markt and bustling port reveal the city’s maritime importance. Sailing north, the Dutch delta unfolds: a wide mosaic of water, dikes, and green pastures.

Veere enchants with its storage houses, canals, and sea views, while Bruinisse, the “mussel village,” offers authentic maritime charm with fishing boats and tidal flats.

Willemstad impresses with its star-shaped fortress layout and historic streets, surrounded by open waters.

In Dordrecht, the oldest Dutch city, canals, churches, and merchant houses recall centuries of trade. The surrounding polders and windmills emphasize the close link between land and water.

Rotterdam presents a bold contrast with modern architecture, the Erasmus Bridge, and Europe’s largest port, embodying a dynamic, international character.

The cruise ends in Amsterdam, where tree-lined canals, merchant houses, and world-class museums create a unique atmosphere. A city of history and openness, it provides a fitting finale to this river journey.

Our route takes you along the majestic Elbe and the romantic Moldau, through a region full of culture, history and natural beauty.

Discover the charming Meissen, world-famous for its fine porcelain, and let yourself be enchanted by the medieval atmosphere. In Wittenberg, follow in the footsteps of Martin Luther and experience the cradle of the Reformation up close. Further downstream, Magdeburg awaits you, a city with over 1200 years of history and impressive architecture such as Magdeburg Cathedral.

The journey takes you through a landscape characterized by rolling hills, lush forests and romantic villages. Enjoy the comfort of a modern river ship on board with first-class service, culinary delights and a varied entertainment program.

This cruise is an unforgettable experience for all those who appreciate authentic cultural landscapes, architectural masterpieces and warm hospitality. Let yourself be inspired by the unique flair of eastern Germany - a region where past and present come together in wonderful harmony.

title: The Legacy of Ancient Trade Routes
description:
The cruise begins in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural gem, with its cathedral, old town, and modern flair. Surrounded by vineyards, the ship sails to Breisach, offering views of the Kaiserstuhl hills.

In Strasbourg, French elegance meets German tradition. The cathedral, “La Petite France,” and canals create a romantic atmosphere. Mannheim follows with its baroque palace and vibrant city life.

Sailing through the Romantic Rhine, the ship arrives in Rüdesheim, where vineyards and the lively Drosselgasse await. The Moselle valley unfolds with Treis-Karden and Cochem, the latter crowned by Reichsburg Castle and framed by steep vineyards.

Back on the Rhine, Cologne impresses with its UNESCO cathedral and bustling old town. Düsseldorf offers a mix of modern architecture, Königsallee, and lively nightlife.

Crossing into the Netherlands, Nijmegen charms as the country’s oldest city. In Amsterdam, canals, merchant houses, and world-class museums invite exploration. Rotterdam showcases daring modern architecture and Europe’s largest port, while Dordrecht delights with canals and maritime history.

In Belgium, Antwerp offers diamonds, fashion, and Rubens’ art. The journey concludes in Brussels, with the Grand Place, Art Nouveau architecture, and European flair marking the perfect finale.

title: A Journey from Hannover to Rhineland Splendor
description: This trip starts in Hanover and takes you along the Mittelland Canal through the varied landscapes of north-western Germany. In Minden and Bergeshövede, locks, canals and water bridges accompany the journey - impressive evidence of German engineering. The journey continues via Münster, Datteln and Herne to the Ruhr region, where history, culture and modern life come together. In Duisburg, the ship reaches the Rhine, before the journey comes to an end in Cologne and finally in Düsseldorf with the joie de vivre of the Rhineland.

title: Discover the Heart of Alsace
description:
The river cruise begins in Nuremberg, a city of history and culture. The Imperial Castle dominates the old town, with half-timbered houses and winding alleys preserving its medieval charm.

Next is Bamberg, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With its cathedral, the Old Town Hall perched on a bridge, and romantic alleys, the city is surrounded by hills and vineyards, giving it a fairy-tale atmosphere.

In Würzburg, the magnificent Residence Palace showcases baroque grandeur. The fortress, old bridge with statues, and the surrounding vineyards highlight the city’s mix of culture and wine tradition.

Wertheim, where the Tauber meets the Main, offers a tranquil setting with a hilltop castle, half-timbered houses, and a dreamy river landscape.

Aschaffenburg follows, famous for Johannisburg Castle and its gardens. Renaissance architecture blends with modern lifestyle here.

In Mannheim, the Rhine opens up with an impressive harbor panorama. The grid city features its baroque palace and cultural diversity, surrounded by the wine-growing Palatinate.

The journey ends in Strasbourg, where French elegance and German heritage meet. The cathedral, “La Petite France,” and canals create a unique atmosphere, framed by Alsatian vineyards and the Vosges Mountains. A fitting finale to a cruise rich in landscapes and culture.

title: Bavarian Advent
description:
Autumn Getaway: Book by 30 September 2026 and receive a €200 flight credit towards your journey.

Experience the magic of the Advent season on an unforgettable river cruise along the Danube. Your journey begins in Vienna, where the festively decorated Christmas market in front of City Hall, the scent of cinnamon, mulled wine, and roasted chestnuts, and atmospheric music will transport you into a Christmas wonderland. The magnificent boulevards are aglow with lights, stirring a sense of anticipation for Christmas.

The journey continues to Dürnstein, a charming little town in the Wachau region, where the medieval alleyways and the ruins overlooking the Danube take on a particularly romantic atmosphere in the gentle snowfall. A visit to the impressive Melk Abbey, considered a jewel of Baroque architecture, brings you into contact with culture and history in a truly memorable way.

In Linz and Passau, you’ll experience the Danube decked out in lights: the artfully decorated Christmas markets invite you to stroll, marvel, and enjoy. Handcrafted gifts, regional specialties, and musical performances create a warm, festive atmosphere.

The grand finale is your stay in Regensburg, where the UNESCO-protected Old Town shines in winter splendor. In particular, the romantic Christmas market in the courtyard of Thurn und Taxis Castle offers a fairytale setting. The festively decorated alleyways, the scent of freshly baked cookies, and the soft strains of Christmas carols make this city seem like something out of a winter fairy tale.

This trip uniquely combines historic charm, cultural highlights, and the special atmosphere of the pre-Christmas season. Let yourself be enchanted by the tranquility of the river, the festive markets, and the snow-covered landscape—a contemplative getaway that touches the heart and the senses.

title: From the Danube’s Whispering Waters to the Rhine’s Storied Rocks
description:
The cruise begins in Vienna, with imperial palaces, St. Stephen’s Cathedral, and a vibrant musical heritage. In Dürnstein, the blue abbey tower and cobbled lanes capture the charm of the Wachau.

Melk impresses with its baroque Benedictine Abbey overlooking the Danube. At Passau, the “city of three rivers,” the Danube meets the Inn and Ilz.

In Regensburg, a UNESCO site, guests admire the medieval old town, Stone Bridge, and Gothic cathedral. Nuremberg reveals history with its imperial castle, timber-framed houses, and festive traditions.

Bamberg enchants with its Old Town Hall built in the river and famous smoked beer. In Würzburg, the baroque Residence Palace dominates the skyline.

The charming town of Wertheim offers a ruined castle and quaint alleys, before arriving in Frankfurt, where skyscrapers rise beside the medieval Römer square.

In Ludwigshafen, the gateway to the Palatinate wine region, excursions beckon. Strasbourg combines French elegance with German heritage, its cathedral and “La Petite France” as highlights.

Breisach welcomes with St. Stephen’s Cathedral and Kaiserstuhl vineyards, before the cruise concludes in Basel, Switzerland’s cultural capital, rich in art, history, and international flair.

title: A Journey from Canalside Charm to Hanseatic Splendor
description: Your journey begins in Amsterdam, the Dutch capital, which delights with its canals, museums and historical charm. From here, the cruise leads northwards through the vast landscapes of the Netherlands. In Enkhuizen and Lemmer, you will experience the maritime heritage of the IJsselmeer, before Groningen impresses with its lively culture and historic old town. Via Leer and Papenburg, you continue through the Frisian inland with its typical waterways and locks. In Oldenburg and Bremerhaven, North German flair awaits you, characterized by maritime history and a modern harbour atmosphere. The final stop in Bremen, with its impressive old town and famous market square, is the atmospheric highlight of this varied journey between Holland and northern Germany.

title: From Berlin To Belgium’s Heartland
description:
Start in Berlin, a city full of vibrant energy, cultural diversity and impressive history. Experience iconic sights such as the Brandenburg Gate, Museum Island and the trendy Kreuzberg district before starting your journey on the Elbe. The river takes you westwards through idyllic landscapes, past Brandenburg, where you will be greeted by lush greenery, tranquil forests and picturesque villages.

Along the route, you will discover Oldenburg, a city with historical flair. The well-kept old town alleyways, cobbled streets and classicist façades invite you to take a stroll. Continue on to Papenburg, where the rich shipbuilding tradition comes to life at the Meyer Werft shipyard - a highlight for technology enthusiasts and culture lovers alike.

The journey finally takes you to Brussels, the heart of Europe. Here, medieval charm with guild houses, winding alleyways and the impressive Grand-Place meet modern elegance, for example in the European Quarter or in the city's design museums. Enjoy Belgian chocolates, waffles and a glass of Belgian beer while you soak up the diversity of the city.

This journey is a celebration of the European waterways, a tribute to the culture, history and joie de vivre along the way. Let yourself drift - from city to city, from experience to experience!

title: A Tapestry of Prussian Stories & Lower Saxon Scenes
description: This journey begins in Berlin Spandau, where the flair of the capital meets the water landscape. Via Potsdam and Brandenburg, the route leads past castles, lakes and historic riverside towns. In Magdeburg, the cityscape impresses with its cathedral and waterway intersection, before continuing via Wolfsburg and Braunschweig, where tradition and innovation stand side by side. The final destination of Hanover combines urban elegance with a green quality of life - a successful conclusion to a varied river trip through the heart of Germany.

title: Alsace to Franconia – A Passage of Heritage & Charm
description:
The cruise begins in Strasbourg, where French elegance and German tradition blend. The cathedral and the picturesque district of “La Petite France” showcase the city’s charm. Cruising the Rhine reveals vineyard slopes and lush riverbanks before reaching the Main.

In Mainz, culture takes center stage with its cathedral, the Gutenberg Museum, and lively old town. The surrounding hills, covered with vineyards, frame the city beautifully.

Miltenberg enchants with timber-framed houses set between forested hills. In Wertheim, at the confluence of Main and Tauber, castle ruins rise above the river – a landscape straight out of a painting.

Würzburg impresses with the Residenz Palace, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, its historic Main Bridge, and terraced vineyards.

The journey continues to Marktbreit, a charming town with baroque architecture and winding alleys, nestled in gentle countryside.

In Bamberg, the old town spans seven hills. The town hall in the middle of the river, grand churches, and the taste of smoky beer make it unforgettable.

Finally, Nuremberg awaits, rich in medieval flair and imperial history. The castle, old towers, and vibrant squares provide a fitting finale to a cruise combining landscapes, culture, and heritage.

title: Nordic Elegance Along the River
description: This cruise combines the Hanseatic flair of Bremen with the cultural diversity of Berlin. From Bremen, the cruise takes you along the idyllic Weser through places such as Hoya, Nienburg and Hanover-Anderten, where you can experience the serenity and history of northern Germany. The journey continues east along the Mittelland Canal via Braunschweig and Magdeburg. In Brandenburg, Potsdam and Berlin Spandau, the water landscape shows itself from its most beautiful side - characterized by lakes, castles and green expanses. A varied journey that combines the best of two worlds. Northern German tranquillity and Berlin lifestyle.
